As a Sales VA, you’ll take ownership of the post-demo sales process. You’ll work closely with our Account Executives to follow up with prospects after their demos, answer questions, handle objections, maintain momentum, and help convert qualified opportunities into customers.



This is not a general administrative VA role. We’re looking for someone with a strong sales background who is comfortable having sales conversations, following up with prospects, overcoming objections, and moving opportunities toward a purchase.



Candidates with previous SDR, BDR, Account Executive, Inside Sales, Appointment Setter, or Business Development experience are strongly preferred.



Compensation

Starting at $1,000+ USD per month, depending on experience and performance.



Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, aligned with US business hours.



Responsibilities

Manage and own follow-up with prospects after demos

Follow up consistently through
 and other communication channels

Answer prospect questions and provide additional information

Understand prospect needs, concerns, and buying intent

Handle objections and confidently communicate the value of our product

Identify buying signals and move prospects toward the next step

Help convert qualified prospects into customers

Re-engage prospects who have gone quiet or are not yet ready to buy

Maintain personalized and timely follow-up throughout the sales process

Coordinate with Account Executives when additional follow-up or information is needed

Keep CRM records, deal stages, notes, and follow-up tasks accurate

Ensure qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks

Track follow-up activity and sales outcomes

Assist with other sales-related tasks as needed



Requirements

Previous experience in sales, SDR, BDR, inside sales, appointment setting, or business development

Demonstrated ability to sell and move prospects through a sales process

Comfortable following up with prospects after a demo or sales call

Strong objection-handling and communication skills

Excellent written and verbal English

Confident communicating with business owners and decision-makers

Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills

Experience using CRM and sales tools

Highly organized and able to manage multiple opportunities

Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote sales environment

Reliable internet connection and computer

Available to work full-time during US business hours



Strongly Preferred

SDR or BDR experience

B2B sales experience

SaaS, software, or services sales experience

Experience managing post-demo follow-up

Experience handling objections and closing sales

Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets



What We Offer

Full-time remote position

Starting compensation of $1,000+ USD/month, depending on experience and performance

Long-term opportunity with room for growth

Opportunity to grow within the sales team

Supportive and collaborative remote team environment

Training, coaching, and ongoing sales support



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

A brief introduction about yourself

Your resume

Your availability and how soon you can start

A brief overview of your sales experience



We are specifically looking for candidates with real sales experience and the ability to sell. Candidates with SDR, BDR, Account Executive, Inside Sales, or Business Development backgrounds will be strongly preferred.



We are actively reviewing applications and hiring multiple Sales VAs, so early applications are encouraged.

title: QUICKBOOKS ONLINE CLEANUP BOOKKEEPER
description:
This is a historical bookkeeping cleanup covering January 1, 2024 through September 30, 2026.



The project contains approximately 3,000–4,000 bank and credit-card transactions. The activity must be accurately separated among:



• A self-employed real estate professional

• One short-term rental property

• One long-term rental property

• Personal and nondeductible activity

• Transfers and credit-card payments

• Transactions requiring client clarification



The work will be completed in one new QuickBooks Online file using classes to track each business and rental activity separately.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Assist with completing the QuickBooks Online setup.



• Import historical bank and credit-card transactions for 2024, 2025 and January–September 2026.



• Review the imports for duplicates and missing periods.



• Categorize business, rental, personal, transfer and owner transactions accurately.



• Assign the correct class to every applicable business or rental transaction.



• Separate the real estate business from both rental properties.



• Identify repairs, improvements, fixed assets, loan payments, owner transactions and unclear activity.



• Match transfers and credit-card payments correctly.



• Reconcile each applicable account month by month.



• Maintain a detailed question log for unclear transactions.



• Avoid guessing when adequate documentation is unavailable.



• Prepare clean financial reports for senior review.



• Correct errors identified during the review process.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Strong QuickBooks Online experience.



• Demonstrated experience with historical cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping.



• Experience importing high-volume bank and credit-card transactions.



• Experience with class tracking and Profit and Loss by Class reporting.



• Experience reconciling mixed-use accounts.



• Familiarity with US sole-proprietor bookkeeping.



• Familiarity with US rental-property bookkeeping.



• Understanding of owner contributions, owner draws, transfers, loan principal, interest, repairs and capital improvements.



• Strong written English and clear communication.



• Excellent attention to detail.



• Willingness to follow established procedures and maintain client confidentiality.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Bookkeeping for real estate agents or brokers.



• Short-term rental or Airbnb bookkeeping.



• Long-term residential rental bookkeeping.



• Experience preparing books for US Schedule C and Schedule E tax reporting.



• Experience working for a US bookkeeping, accounting or tax firm.



PROJECT EXPECTATIONS



• Begin as soon as onboarding and security requirements are completed.



• Provide consistent progress updates.



• Track time accurately if engaged hourly.



• Maintain a running list of questions rather than making unsupported assumptions.



• Meet agreed deadlines.



• Use only the assigned login and approved systems.



• Do not share access, outsource the work or download client information to an unauthorized device.



This position begins as a project-based independent-contractor role and may develop into regular monthly bookkeeping work for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



Your hourly or project rate.



Your availability and estimated weekly capacity.



Your years of QuickBooks Online experience.



A description of one historical cleanup project you completed.



Your experience with real estate agents, short-term rentals or long-term rentals.



Your process for handling unclear transactions.



Your process for reviewing duplicates and reconciling historical imports.



The QuickBooks Online certifications you currently hold, if any.



Confirmation that you are willing to sign an independent-contractor agreement, confidentiality agreement and data-security agreement.

title: Guest Experience Specialist
description:
Excellent spoken English is the most important requirement for this role. Guests will hear you on the phone. We will teach you the software and our process.



Sonoma Coastal Collection is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving California's Sonoma Coast — Sea Ranch, Gualala, Sonoma, and the surrounding coastal communities — with over 200 curated vacation homes. Our deep connection to this region is what inspired us to build Sonoma Coastal Collection. We are focused on providing thoughtful, memorable stays for our guests and reliable, attentive stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that honors what makes the Sonoma Coast special — its dramatic coastline, redwood forests, tight-knit communities, and slower pace of life — while delivering exceptional experiences for guests and trusted, long-term partnerships for homeowners.

Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), Akia (guest messaging), Zoom Phone (calls).

Our Promises



Everything we do is guided by our Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



Thoughtful Guest Engagement: Proactive, genuine hospitality from booking to five-star review. We believe vacations are special — something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns a great trip into an unforgettable coastal experience.



Attentive Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own. As people who live and work on this coast, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Regular home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation-ready — for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



Trusted Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment. Every homeowner has different goals — maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.

Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist — Sonoma Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Sonoma Coastal Collection, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. This role is built around answering phones and helping with guest messaging in Akia. Excellent spoken English matters more than prior software experience — we will teach you Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, and Zoom Phone, and we will teach you our process. You will also coordinate work orders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring thoughtful hospitality to every stay.



You will own:

Answer guest calls and return missed calls promptly (Zoom Phone)

Guest messaging in Akia, with warmth and clarity

Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

Work order coordination and task follow-through

Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

This is one fixed schedule. There is no shift rotation.

Days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday

Hours: 9:00am–6:00pm Pacific Time

Days off: Friday and Saturday



Shift length: 9 hours, including up to 90 minutes of self-scheduled break time

Philippines time during Pacific Daylight Time (roughly March–November): 12:00am–9:00am PHT

Philippines time during Pacific Standard Time (roughly November–March): 1:00am–10:00am PHT

Night shift differential: +$50 USD per month, because this schedule is overnight in the Philippines



Compensation and Incentives

Base pay: $650–$750 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

Night shift differential: +$50 per month

Internet/tech allowance: $20 per month

13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)



Monthly Bonus: Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool (based on team review quality + individual SLA performance)

PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)

Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool

We keep the bonus simple, measurable, and tied directly to delivering thoughtful guest experiences — the heart of your role.

Pool funding: $2.00 USD for every 5-star review received during the month.

Quality gate: Pool funded only if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 80%+.

Distribution: The funded pool is divided equally among the Guest Experience Team members.

Eligibility: You receive your share when monthly SLA and performance standards are met. Shares are not redistributed from non-eligible members.



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines.



Role and Responsibilities

Phone support (Zoom Phone)

Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

Troubleshoot common issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics, recreation passes) and escalate when needed

Thoughtful Guest Engagement (Akia + text/email)

Answer guest messages in Akia with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/fog, coastal road conditions, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

Ensure every guest experience feels personal and thoughtfully handled

Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

Send a personalized welcome text to find out what, if anything, they are celebrating

Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

Identify opportunities to make the guest's stay a memorable coastal experience

Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless

Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm Pacific the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

Maintain accurate property notes and updates

Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context

Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

Guest messages answered within 5 minutes during your shift (Akia)

Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Local expertise

Become an expert on Sea Ranch, Gualala, and the Sonoma Coast, including seasonal rhythms, coastal weather and fog patterns, Highway 1 road conditions, and local norms.

Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, activities, and experiences in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that make each stay special.

Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, recreation pass usage, and any "good to know" details for guests.

Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including Sea Ranch Association updates and relevant local
 groups).

Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

Excellent spoken English and good written english with a warm, helpful tone. Spoken English is the most important requirement.

Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on busy days

Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

No prior experience with Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, or Zoom Phone is required. We will teach you the software and the process.

Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply

Resume/CV

2-minute video recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

title: Business Development Coordinator — US Legal Services (Part-Time)
description:
West TN Process Services is a Tennessee-based process serving and litigation support company serving attorneys, law firms, and legal professionals throughout 16 counties in West Tennessee.



We provide professional process serving, rush services, court filing and document retrieval, affidavits of service, and related litigation support. We are expanding our attorney relationships and seeking a professional, motivated Business Development Coordinator to introduce our services to law firms throughout our coverage area.



POSITION DETAILS

• Remote — Philippines preferred

• Part-time, initially 8–10 hours weekly

• $6–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Must be available during US Central Time business hours

• Payment is made weekly or biweekly for completed and approved hours, based on the agreed payment schedule. No advance payment is provided.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Research law firms and attorneys within our service territory.

• Make outbound telephone calls to US law offices.

• Professionally introduce West TN Process Services.

• Communicate with receptionists, legal assistants, paralegals, office managers, and attorneys.

• Identify the people responsible for coordinating process serving services.

• Explain our services accurately and professionally.

• Position our company as a reliable primary or backup process serving provider.

• Send approved company information packets to interested firms.

• Conduct professional follow-up calls and
s.

• Schedule conversations with interested decision-makers.

• Maintain accurate prospect and outreach records.

• Provide regular performance reports.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Previous experience making outbound B2B telephone calls to US businesses.

• Proven appointment-setting or business-development experience.

• Confidence communicating with receptionists and decision-makers.

• Professional telephone etiquette.

• Ability to handle objections without aggressive sales tactics.

• Experience using spreadsheets or CRM software.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment.

• Availability during US Central Time business hours.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous experience working with US law firms.

• Familiarity with legal services or professional-service businesses.

• Experience with cold calling and lead generation.

• Experience developing long-term B2B client relationships.



IMPORTANT

This is primarily a telephone outreach position. We are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to
 marketing, LinkedIn messaging, social media management, or inbound customer support. Candidates must be comfortable making actual outbound telephone calls to American businesses.



HOW TO APPLY

Begin your application with the phrase “West Tennessee Outreach” and include:

1. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

2. Details about your previous outbound B2B calling experience.

3. Your experience communicating with US businesses.

4. Your expected hourly rate.

5. Your availability during US Central Time.

6. A short English voice recording introducing yourself professionally.

7. Examples of appointment-setting or business-development results, where available.



Applicants will not be asked to perform unpaid productive outreach. Finalists may be invited to complete a short paid calling simulation.

title: Video Editor - YouTube Long-Form + Shorts (Ongoing Monthly Retainer)
description:
We run an acquisition agency and we're scaling two YouTube channels with the same format. We need one editor who can hold a consistent standard, week in week out, on an ongoing basis. This is not a one-off gig.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Two brands, one format, so you learn the style once and apply it to both.



16 long-form YouTube videos per month. Capped at 15 minutes, usually 10 to 12.

Up to 60 shorts per month, cut from those long-forms and from raw clips we send, formatted for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



Expect around 13 to 15 hours a week.



Only two video types:



Lifestyle / story videos — talking head with B-roll cutaways

Technical breakdowns — screen recordings of real dashboards and numbers, composited cleanly



Same template every time. Once you've learned it, it's repeatable work.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



A full package for every single video: the script, editing notes, and a shot list telling you exactly which B-roll clip goes where. You are never guessing what we want.

An organised Google Drive with labelled and indexed B-roll, horizontal and vertical.

Fast feedback. One revision round, not endless nitpicking.

We run AI tools for the first pass on rough cuts and captions, so the grunt work is partly done before it reaches you. Your job is polish and judgment.



PAY



Monthly retainer, paid on time, every time. No chasing, no invoicing battles.



16 long-form + up to 30 shorts = $400/month

16 long-form + up to 60 shorts = $550/month (this is where we're starting)

16 long-form + up to 90 shorts = $700/month



The long-form count is steady at 16. The shorts are what moves, so you get paid for the tier you actually deliver. We start at $550 and you move up the moment the volume does. We are not going to argue about it or make you ask twice. Payment by Wise, PayPal, or whatever works for you.



PAID TRIAL



Before any ongoing arrangement we pay $15 to $25 for one trial edit on a real video, 48 hour turnaround. We do not ask anyone to work for free.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



A reel, or 3 recent long-form videos you edited start to finish

Ability to composite screen recordings and screenshots cleanly. This is most of the technical videos, so it matters more than anything else on this list

Genuinely fast at cutting vertical shorts out of long-form. This is a big chunk of the volume, so speed here counts

First cut within 48 hours

Consistency. Available every week, ongoing



SOFTWARE: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or CapCut. We don't mind which, we care about the output.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:



Your reel or 3 examples of long-form YouTube you cut start to finish

Your monthly rate

Your typical first-cut turnaround with your current workload

One thing you would change about a video you did not make. Any video, your choice.

Data Engineer – Snowflake / Python / PySpark 



About the Role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our data team and own the ingestion, pipelines,

and infrastructure that get raw data reliably into our warehouse and ready for use. This role

is primarily focused on building and maintaining the data pipeline layer - ingesting data from

source systems, orchestrating workflows, and ensuring data lands in Snowflake accurately,

on time, and at scale.



What You'll Do

● Design, build, and own end-to-end data pipelines that ingest data from a wide range

of source systems (databases, APIs, event streams, third-party files) into our data

warehouse

● Build and maintain reliable ingestion frameworks that handle batch and/or streaming

data at scale

● Use Python and PySpark to build scalable extraction and processing jobs, including

large-scale/distributed data processing

● Build, schedule, and monitor pipelines using an orchestration tool, including

dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLAs

● Write efficient, production-grade SQL for data transformation, validation, and

troubleshooting across the pipeline

● Maintain dbt models where needed to support standardized, tested transformations

downstream of ingestion

● Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch pipeline failures and

data issues before they hit downstream consumers

● Partner with Product owners, data analysts, and software engineers to understand

upstream source systems and downstream data needs

● Contribute to data infrastructure and architecture decisions (e.g., ingestion patterns,

storage layout, orchestration strategy)

● Maintain clear documentation of pipeline architecture & data lineage



What We're Looking For

● Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines end-to-end,

from ingestion through delivery

● 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Snowflake (or a similar cloud data

warehouse) in a production environment

● Strong proficiency in Python for building ingestion jobs, automation, and data

processing

● Experience with PySpark for distributed data processing at scale

● Hands-on experience with a workflow orchestration tool (e.g., Apache Airflow,

Dagster, Prefect, or similar) for scheduling and monitoring pipelines

● Strong SQL skills for data transformation, debugging, and validation

● Working knowledge of dbt for downstream transformation and testing

● Experience integrating with diverse data sources (relational databases, REST APIs,

event/streaming systems, flat files)

● Understanding of data pipeline reliability practices: retries, idempotency, monitoring,

and alerting

● Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

● Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with analytics,

engineering, and business stakeholders



Nice to Have

● Experience with streaming/event-based ingestion (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or

similar)

● Experience with CI/CD for data pipelines

● Experience with version control (Git) and code review workflows

● Background in a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

● Experience working in an agile data team environment



***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



How to Apply:

To apply for this role, please submit a link to your resume and a brief Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and highlighting your skills relevant to the role. In your video, please address the following:

- A short introduction of yourself and why you're interested in this role.

- Your current and previous experience as a Data Engineer and specific experience with Snowflake / Python / PySpark

- Key skills or qualifications that make you a strong fit for this position.



Please note: Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We look forward to welcoming a passionate developer who prioritizes clean code, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

- Clean, accurate captions and good written English

- A computer that can handle a 4-camera 1080p timeline, and internet fast enough to download a full episode's files without a long wait

title: Sales & Operational Manager - Virtual Assistant (Housekeeping Business)
description:
We are a growing U.S. based cleaning and housekeeping company specializing in short-term rental turnovers, including Airbnb properties. We help property owners and hosts maintain consistent cleaning quality, reliable scheduling, and an excellent guest and client experience.



We are looking for a dependable, organized, and proactive Sales and Operations Manager to help manage daily operations, coordinate our cleaning team, communicate with clients, and generate new business.



This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, solves problems independently, and wants to grow alongside a developing business.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Sales and Business Development



- Respond to inbound calls,
s, messages, and cleaning inquiries, converting qualified leads into paying customers.

- Make outbound calls and send messages to potential clients, including short-term rental hosts and property managers.

- Generate new leads through social media engagement, cold outreach, referrals, and other organic sales efforts.

- Follow up with prospective and existing clients to build relationships and secure new business.

- Track leads, sales activity, conversion rates, and follow-ups in the company's CRM or tracking systems.

- Provide accurate information about services, answer questions, and confidently communicate the value of GuestMaids.

- Work toward a target sales close rate of 40% or higher.



2. Operations and Customer Service



- Coordinate daily and weekly cleaning schedules to ensure all jobs are assigned and completed on time.

- Communicate with cleaners, monitor progress, and address scheduling needs.

- Handle last-minute cancellations, cleaner call-outs, no-shows, and other operational issues.

- Respond promptly (within 10 minutes) to client inquiries, requests, schedule changes, and minor complaints.

- Monitor ongoing cleaning jobs and ensure reported issues and follow-ups are resolved.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date schedules in our booking software.

- Monitor cleaner performance and escalate significant issues to the owner when necessary.

- Maintain professional communication with clients, cleaners, and other team members.



3. Cleaner Recruitment and Onboarding



- Maintain and update job descriptions and online job listings for cleaner positions.

- Review applications, communicate with candidates, and conduct initial interviews.

- Assist with recruiting, selecting, and onboarding reliable cleaners.

- Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline to support the company's growth.

- Help ensure new cleaners understand company expectations, cleaning standards, and operational procedures.



4. Marketing and Online Presence



- Manage and update the company's social media accounts.

- Maintain the company's Google Business Profile, including posting updates and responding to reviews.

- Update website content and assist with improving the website's appearance, usability, and search engine optimization (SEO).

- Help develop practical marketing strategies to attract new clients and strengthen the company's online presence.



5. Administrative and Special Projects



- Maintain accurate client records, sales information, schedules, and other business documentation.

- Complete assigned business and administrative tasks within established deadlines.

- Assist with process improvements, documentation (i.e. SOP), and projects that improve operational efficiency.

- Take ownership of assigned tasks and provide updates on progress and outstanding issues.

- Assist with other reasonable business or administrative tasks as needed.



Requirements and Qualifications:



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Previous experience in sales, customer service, virtual assistance, operations, or administrative support.

- Comfortable making outbound calls, following up with leads, and selling services over the phone or through messages.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle unexpected situations calmly.

- Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, online platforms, and business software.

- Willingness to learn and use tools such as Notion, ConvertLabs, Breezeway, CRM systems, scheduling software, and website management platforms.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

-  A proactive mindset: able to identify problems, suggest solutions, and take action without waiting for instructions on every task.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for professional remote work.

- Ability to work effectively in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

- Experience in the cleaning, housekeeping, Airbnb, or property management industry.

- Experience recruiting and coordinating cleaners or independent contractors.

- Familiarity with social media management, Google Business Profile, website editing, and basic SEO.



Work Schedule:



- Part-time or Full-time position, with the initial schedule agreed upon with the successful candidate.

- Working hours will be coordinated around U.S. Eastern Time (8:30AM to 5:30PM)

- Availability during agreed-upon working hours is important to ensure timely responses to clients and cleaners.



Compensation and Bonuses:



* **Base pay:** Hourly compensation, agreed upon before starting.

* **Payment schedule:** Biweekly payments through Wise.

* **Monthly KPI bonus:** An additional 5% of the month's base pay if all established monthly key performance indicators (KPIs) are met.

* **New revenue bonus:** 1% of new revenue booked. For example, booking $1,000 in new business earns a $10 bonus.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by the following:



Scheduling and reliability: Cleaning jobs are assigned and completed as scheduled, with minimal errors or delays.

Customer service: Client inquiries and messages receive a response within 10 minutes during working hours, whenever reasonably possible.

Customer satisfaction: Clients and guests consistently receive the high-quality service expected from GuestMaids.

Cleaner coordination: Cleaners receive clear communication, feel supported, and have the information needed to complete their assignments successfully.

Sales performance: Maintain a target close rate of 40% or higher for qualified sales leads.

Lead management: Keep sales records updated and ensure prospective clients receive timely follow-ups.

Task completion: Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.



Work Leave and Communication Expectations:



- Requests for more than two consecutive days off should be submitted at least seven days in advance.

- Other planned time-off requests should be submitted at least 48 hours in advance.

- If leaving the position, the employee is expected to provide at least 14 days' notice.

- Maintain professional communication and notify the owner promptly about absences, delays, or issues affecting work.



Technical Requirements:



- A dedicated workstation at home.

- A stable internet connection of at least 30 Mbps.

- A backup internet solution and access to backup devices or power arrangements when needed.

- A quiet working environment suitable for calls and professional communication.



How to Apply?



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and why you are the best candidate for this role? Please send your video to 



We care about more than getting tasks done. We want to build a team of people we can trust to do the right thing, care about others, and take ownership of their work.



Our values guide how we make decisions, communicate, and serve our customers. We’re looking for someone who genuinely identifies with these values and demonstrates them through their daily actions.



1. Excellence

 Do the Job Right, Even When No One Is Watching.



We take pride in our work and pay attention to the details. We don't cut corners or wait for someone to check our work. Whether you're updating a cleaning schedule, responding to a customer, following up with a lead, or completing an administrative task, you take responsibility for doing it correctly.



2. Honest and Fair

Tell the Truth and Treat People Right.



We communicate honestly, take responsibility for mistakes, and treat customers, cleaners, and teammates fairly. If something goes wrong, we address it instead of hiding it. We value people who can be trusted to give accurate updates, keep their commitments, and do the right thing even when it's uncomfortable.



3. Care About People 

Look Out for Our Customers and Each Other.



Our business depends on trust and strong relationships. We want someone who genuinely cares about helping customers, supporting cleaners, and making things easier for the people they work with. You listen, show empathy, communicate respectfully, and look for solutions that are fair and practical.



4. Always Growing 

Keep Learning and Getting Better.



We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We do expect you to be curious, open to feedback, and willing to improve. You learn from mistakes, look for better ways to do things, and take initiative to develop your skills. As GuestMaids grows, we want you to grow with us.



5. Go With the Flow 

Adapt Without Losing Your Cool.



Cleaning operations can change quickly. A cleaner might cancel, a customer might change a schedule, or an urgent issue might need attention. We need someone who can adjust priorities, stay calm under pressure, and focus on solving the problem rather than getting frustrated. We value flexibility, practical thinking, and a positive approach to change.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. You don't need someone reminding you about every task or telling you what to do at every step. You notice what needs attention, communicate when something is wrong, and follow through until the job is done.



You care about the quality of your work, treat people fairly, and understand that small details can make a big difference to customers and the team.



We're looking for someone who wants to be part of a growing business, contribute ideas, solve problems, and build systems that help the company run better over time.



If these values reflect how you naturally work, not just what you think an employer wants to hear, we'd like to meet you!

title: Hospitality / Airbnb Operations Specialist
description:
# ALL-STAR Virtual Assistant – Airbnb & Hospitality Operations



**Company:** VCAY Suites  

**Location:** Remote  

**Position:** Full-Time  

**Industry:** Hospitality / Short-Term Rentals



## We're Hiring an ALL-STAR Virtual Assistant!



VCAY Suites is a growing hospitality company in New Orleans operating large multi-bedroom hotel suites for families, groups, and corporate travelers.



We're looking for an **exceptional Virtual Assistant with real, hands-on Airbnb experience** who can think independently, solve problems quickly, and manage multiple responsibilities without constant supervision.



**This is NOT an entry-level position.**



We need someone intelligent, organized, resourceful, tech-savvy, and extremely detail-oriented.



If you need someone constantly reminding you what to do, this is not the right position.



If you're someone who sees a problem, figures out the solution, and takes ownership until it's resolved, we want to hear from you.



## Responsibilities



- Manage Airbnb guest messages, inquiries, reservation changes, and requests.

- Answer guest phone calls professionally and confidently.

- Coordinate guest check-ins, checkouts, early arrivals, and late departures.

- Monitor upcoming reservations and identify potential issues before arrival.

- Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, and inspections with on-site staff.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks until they are completed.

- Handle guest complaints, troubleshoot issues, and escalate emergencies appropriately.

- Review new reservations for accuracy and update reservation notes.

- Assist with Airbnb reviews, refunds, and reservation modifications.

- Maintain accurate operational records and communicate updates to the team.

- Identify mistakes, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve our systems.



## Requirements



**Previous Airbnb experience is REQUIRED.**



- Minimum 1 year of hands-on Airbnb or short-term rental management experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Comfortable handling difficult guests and unexpected situations.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Experience using property management systems and guest messaging platforms.

- Ability to learn new software quickly.

- Reliable internet, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.

- Comfortable working on camera during assigned shifts.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.



**Experience with Mews, Breezeway, Hospitable, 
, Expedia, Slack, and WhatsApp is a major plus.**



## What We're Really Looking For



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions.



We want someone who thinks.



If a guest reports an issue, you investigate it.



If a cleaner hasn't completed a room, you follow up before the guest arrives.



If a reservation looks incorrect, you catch it.



If something is overdue, you take action instead of waiting for someone to remind you.



**We value intelligence, urgency, accountability, communication, and common sense.**



You'll be working in a fast-paced hospitality environment where accuracy and quick decision-making matter.



## REQUIRED: Video Introduction



**Every applicant MUST submit a 2–3 minute video recording answering these five questions:**



1. Introduce yourself and describe your experience managing Airbnb properties.

2. How many Airbnb listings have you managed, and what were your daily responsibilities?

3. Tell us about a difficult guest situation you personally resolved.

4. A guest arrives at 3 PM, but their room isn't ready, the cleaner isn't responding, and the guest is upset. What exactly would you do?

description:

**MUST HAVE STRONG ENGLISH COMMUNICATION SKILLS, SALES EXPERIENCE & VEHICLE KNOWLEDGE**



We are seeking a confident, motivated, and results-driven **Reservations & Sales Specialist** to join our growing U.S.-based rental car company.



This position is focused on **answering inbound calls, converting inquiries into bookings, following up with potential customers, and delivering excellent customer service.**



We are not looking for someone who simply reads scripts or answers basic questions. We need someone who can lead conversations, understand customer needs, confidently explain rental options, and close reservations.



Key Responsibilities



Inbound Calls & Reservations

- Answer incoming calls professionally and confidently.

- Identify why customers are calling before offering solutions.

- Convert rental inquiries and price shoppers into confirmed bookings.

- Explain vehicle options, pricing, deposits, protection products, and rental policies.

- Assist customers with reservations, extensions, and booking questions.



Sales & Lead Follow-Up

- Follow up with potential customers through phone calls, SMS, and
.

- Handle pricing objections and customer hesitation professionally.

- Recommend suitable rental options based on customer needs.

- Encourage customers to complete their reservations.

Customer Service

- Provide excellent customer support over phone, text,
, and chat.

- Resolve basic customer concerns and escalate issues when needed.

- Maintain accurate customer notes and communication records.



Requirements

- **Previous phone sales, reservations, or call center experience REQUIRED.**

- **Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong listening skills.**

- **Basic to strong knowledge of cars, vehicle types, and the U.S. automotive market REQUIRED.**

- Ability to confidently close sales without being pushy.

- Strong understanding of customer needs and problem-solving.

- Comfortable handling objections and difficult conversations.

- Experience using CRM systems or reservation software.

- Reliable internet, quality headset, and quiet work environment.

- Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Car rental, automotive, travel reservations, or hospitality sales.

- Inbound phone sales and appointment setting.

- U.S.-based customer service experience.

- Experience with booking software or GoHighLevel.



Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:



- Number of confirmed reservations

- Booking conversion rate

- Quality of customer conversations

- Lead follow-up performance

- Customer satisfaction

- Accuracy of reservation information

Pay & Schedule

- **Performance Incentives:** Opportunity to earn booking-based bonuses

 How to Apply



 
 with the following:



1. Full name

2. Updated resume

3. A video introduction (60 seconds or less) explaining your phone sales experience and why you're a good fit

"A customer calls asking how much it costs to rent a car for one week. How would you handle the conversation and encourage them to book?"

We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently, build trust, and turn conversations into reservations.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
>>Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Receivable Specialist with strong QuickBooks Online skills to support our finance and accounting operations.

This role requires someone who is highly comfortable working inside QuickBooks Online on a daily basis, including customer invoicing, payment application, account reconciliation, AR aging, credit memos, deposits, and customer account maintenance.



The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with Accounts Receivable and QuickBooks Online, can confidently navigate customer accounts and transactions, and is able to identify and resolve discrepancies without requiring constant guidance.



Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and professional customer communication are essential for this position.



>>Key Responsibilities

- Use QuickBooks Online as the primary accounting platform for Accounts Receivable tasks

- Enter, review, and maintain customer invoices in QuickBooks Online

- Apply customer payments accurately to open invoices

- Record and reconcile payments received via ACH, wire transfer, check, and credit card

- Review customer balances and transaction histories in QuickBooks Online

- Review and maintain the Accounts Receivable Aging Report

- Monitor outstanding balances, payment terms, and invoice due dates

- Follow up professionally with customers regarding past-due invoices and outstanding balances

- Send customer statements, payment reminders, and collection follow-ups

- Communicate with customers regarding payment discrepancies, missing payments, and billing questions

- Post and track customer deposits, prepayments, and account credits

- Create and process credit memos for returns, shortages, billing corrections, or approved adjustments

- Research and resolve invoice, payment, and customer account discrepancies

- Coordinate with Sales and Operations regarding customer orders, invoicing, credits, and billing issues

- Reconcile Accounts Receivable balances to the general ledger

- Assist with bank, payment, and account reconciliations as needed

- Prepare weekly AR aging, collections, and outstanding balance reports for management

- Maintain accurate customer account records and supporting documentation

- Assist with month-end closing and financial reporting related to Accounts Receivable

- Ensure all customer payments are accurately recorded, matched, and processed in a timely manner



>>Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online is required

- Must be highly comfortable navigating QuickBooks Online independently

- Experience creating and managing invoices, applying payments, reviewing customer balances, processing deposits, and handling credit memos in QuickBooks Online

- Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes, including AR aging, collections, payment application, and account reconciliation

- Previous experience in Accounts Receivable, bookkeeping, accounting support, or a similar finance role

- Ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies within customer accounts

- Comfortable communicating professionally with customers regarding outstanding invoices and payment issues

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial records

- Good organizational and time-management skills

- Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills



>>Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced or extensive experience using QuickBooks Online

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based company

- Experience working with B2B customers

- Familiarity with ACH, wire transfers, checks, credit card payments, deposits, and credit memos

- Experience assisting with month-end reconciliation and financial reporting

- Experience coordinating with Sales, Operations, or Customer Service teams regarding billing issues



>>What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not only familiar with QuickBooks Online, but can use it confidently and independently as part of their day-to-day work.



This role is best suited for someone who has already worked extensively inside QuickBooks Online and understands how Accounts Receivable transactions flow through the system. The successful candidate should be able to review accounts, identify discrepancies, apply payments correctly, monitor aging balances, follow up on overdue invoices, and help ensure that AR records remain accurate and organized.



Applicants with only basic or limited QuickBooks exposure may not be a strong fit for this position.



Send your application to 
 with the subject: A-Game AR - (your name)

1. Resume link

2. OLJ link

3. Short self-intro that includes your QuickBooks experience summary



Working hours: 10am to 2pm/3pm PST

title: Motion Video Editor & Social Campaigns - AI Start Up
description:
Motion Video Editor — EchoVerse Collective



We're a startup AI-native media company. Our flagship product, Dispatches, is a personalised daily AI brief. Four AI columnists write it and a named human editor approves it before anything ships. We publish every day, but almost nobody sees it yet. Your job is to change that.



The role

* Edit and animate. Short-form vertical cuts from our articles and audio editions, plus founder talking-heads, product walkthroughs and launch films. You own the motion graphics, kinetic type, subtitles, sound, pace and colour.

* Run the channels. Plan, schedule and write copy for LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, at a posting rhythm we can sustain.

* Run paid social. Audiences, creative tests, budgets and a weekly honest report on what’s working.

* Build the machine. Templates, motion presets, caption styles, a shot library and prompt libraries. If you make something twice, it becomes a template.

You’d be our only editor. There’s no committee: you make it, we review it together, it ships.



You’ll fit if you

* Are strong in Premiere, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects, with real motion and kinetic typography skills

* Have made short-form video that performed, and can explain why it performed

* Have run paid social campaigns with real budgets

* Use generative tools (Veo, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs, HeyGen) well, and know when output isn’t good enough to ship

* Write sharp English copy, and report status honestly



Bonus: podcast/audio editing, YouTube long-form and thumbnails, analytics, newsletter growth.



Not for you if you want a volume job, need a locked storyboard before you start, or would ship AI output because it was fast.



Package

* PHP 45,000–70,000/month plus a 13th-month bonus

* 3 hours of overlap with London (your afternoon); otherwise you set your own schedule

* All tools, AI credits and a machine that can render are paid for

* Private health cover for your family and a monthly family fund

* Learning budget, paid leave, and pay reviews at 6 and 12 months



How to apply. You need both of these:

1. Three work links (no attachments), with one line each on what the piece was for and what you wanted the viewer to do. Motion work is preferred.

2. A written pitch (a few hundred words). Read one article at 
/dispatches and describe the 30-second vertical video you’d make from it: the first 3 seconds, what’s on screen, where the words come from, and what the viewer should do next.



Subject line: Dispatches video - [name], where [name] is the columnist who covers markets and capital. Wrong subject lines are filtered out automatically.



Process: We shortlist 5–8 people for a paid test edit (PHP 2,500, paid on delivery whatever the outcome).



Then 2–3 people have a 30-minute call, and one person is hired. The whole process takes under two weeks.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.



This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.



For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.



Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.



Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.



Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.



Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.



Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.



Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.



Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.



What we look for



Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.

Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.



Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.



Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.



Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.

Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.



Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Hiring: Skilled 3D Generalist Character Modeler/ Animator
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | Potential Full-Time Position | Indie Game Development



Job Description



We are independent game development studio seeking a talented, creative, and reliable 3D Generalist to assist with several ongoing video game projects.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working across multiple areas of 3D development, including character modeling, environmental modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



This position is intended to develop into a full-time, long-term opportunity for the right candidate.



While specialists are welcome to apply, priority will be given to experienced 3D Generalists who demonstrate strong skills in modeling, high-quality texturing, and character animation.



Our projects primarily involve stylized anime-inspired visuals, immersive environments, and interactive gameplay systems developed in Unreal Engine.



Primary Responsibilities



1. 3D Character Modeling



- Create high-quality, stylized anime-inspired 3D characters from concept art and references.

- Model both male and female characters with accurate anatomy, proportions, and silhouettes.

- Create detailed clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and character variations.

- Develop characters suitable for real-time gameplay.

- Optimize character models while maintaining visual quality.

- Modify and improve existing 3D models when necessary.



2. Texturing and Materials



- Create detailed, professional-quality textures for characters, clothing, props, and environments.

- Work with stylized anime materials and realistic or semi-realistic textures when required.

- Produce clean UV maps and properly organized texture sets.

- Maintain consistent visual quality across different game assets.

- Understand PBR workflows and materials compatible with Unreal Engine.



Strong texturing abilities are extremely important for this position.



3. Character Rigging and Animation



- Rig humanoid characters for gameplay and cinematic sequences.

- Create smooth, natural character animations.

- Produce idle, walking, running, crouching, and other basic movement animations.

- Animate character interactions with environmental objects and other characters.

- Create expressive facial animations, gestures, and body language.

- Develop custom animations based on video references or provided examples.

- Create animations for horror, stealth, simulation, and narrative-driven gameplay.

- Work with existing skeletons and animation systems when possible.



Experience with animation retargeting and Unreal Engine skeleton compatibility is highly desirable.



4. Environmental Modeling and Props



- Create interior and exterior environments for video games.

- Model residential buildings, apartments, houses, stores, and other urban environments.

- Develop furniture, appliances, decorative objects, and interactive props.

- Create environmental assets for horror-themed locations, including mansions and abandoned buildings.

- Optimize environments for real-time performance.

- Work with existing marketplace assets and modify them to fit project requirements.



5. Game Asset Integration



- Prepare and export models for use in Unreal Engine. (And or other game engines as needed)

- Ensure models have appropriate topology, materials, UVs, and skeletal structures.

- Assist with importing and configuring character animations.

- Troubleshoot issues involving meshes, textures, and animation compatibility.

- Collaborate on asset optimization and organization.



Current Project Styles



Our development projects include:



Anime-Inspired Life Simulation



A stylized anime life simulator featuring interactive characters, residential neighborhoods, interior environments, and everyday activities.



Assets may include:



- Anime-style characters and alternate outfits.

- Everyday character animations and interactions.

- Residential buildings and neighborhood assets.

- Furniture, household appliances, and interactive objects.

- Character expressions and relationship-driven animations.



Stealth Horror



A horror experience featuring supernatural humanoid characters, detailed environments, and character-driven interactions.



Assets may include:



- Stylized supernatural and humanoid character models.

- Unique character animations and movement styles.

- Detailed mansion interiors and environmental props.

- Suspenseful character interactions and horror animations.

- Character outfits, accessories, and variations.



Multiplayer Survival Horror



An anime-inspired asymmetric survival horror experience.



Assets may include:



- Stylized playable characters.

- Character outfits and cosmetic variations.

- Movement, combat, and interaction animations.

- Environmental objects and map assets.

- Unique character-specific animations.



Preferred Qualifications



We are primarily interested in candidates who possess:



- 2–5+ years of demonstrable 3D development experience.

- Strong proficiency in Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or comparable 3D software.

- Excellent character modeling and texturing abilities.

- Experience creating stylized anime-inspired characters.

- Practical knowledge of character rigging and animation.

- Familiarity with Unreal Engine workflows.

- Understanding of topology, UV mapping, and optimization.

- Ability to work independently using visual references and written instructions.

- Strong communication skills and professional reliability.

- Ability to provide regular progress updates and meet agreed-upon deadlines.



Experience creating complete game-ready characters, from modeling and texturing through rigging and animation, will receive the highest consideration.



Additional Skills That Are a Plus



- Unreal Engine 5 experience.

- Anime shaders and stylized material creation.

- Facial rigging and expression systems.

- Character clothing and accessory creation.

- Animation retargeting.

- Experience with marketplace assets.

- Blendshapes and morph targets.

- Basic understanding of game development pipelines.

- Experience with mature-rated video game projects.



Important Information



Some of our projects involve mature themes, horror, violence, and adult-oriented content.



Applicants should be comfortable working on projects intended for mature audiences.



Not every project involves mature content, and assignments will vary depending on development requirements.



Employment Opportunity



We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship with a dependable and talented artist.



The position may begin with individual assignments or a paid trial project to evaluate compatibility, work quality, and communication.



Our primary goal is to find the right candidate for consistent, potentially full-time employment.



We value reliability, communication, creativity, and attention to detail just as much as technical ability.



Candidates who consistently deliver quality work and demonstrate versatility will be prioritized for ongoing development opportunities.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio showcasing your best 3D modeling, texturing, and animation work.

2. Your years of professional experience.

3. The 3D software you primarily use.

4. Your experience with Unreal Engine, if applicable.

5. Examples of completed, game-ready character models.

6. Examples of animations you personally created.

7. Your desired monthly salary or hourly rate for long-term employment.

8. Your availability for consistent or full-time work.



Important: Please specify which parts of your portfolio you personally created, particularly modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



Applications demonstrating strong abilities in all three priority areas, modeling, texturing, and animation, will receive preference.



We are particularly interested in artists who are passionate about independent game development and interested in growing alongside our projects.



We look forward to reviewing your work!

title: Virtual Assistant – Business Development Associate – Real Estate—Immediate Start —Multiple Vacancies Available
description:

WAGE / SALARY: $300/month fixed + $50 per let-only instruction + $75 per fully managed instruction (uncapped incentives)

HOURS PER WEEK: 40 hours, mostly UK business hours (approximately 9am–5pm UK / 4pm–midnight Philippine time)



ABOUT US



We’re a growing independent UK estate agency specialising in sales, lettings and property management. We’re part of a global luxury real estate network and are its exclusive lettings provider in the UK.



We have the brand, the agreement and the back office. What we need is someone who can turn that into a steady flow of landlord instructions.



THE ROLE



Your job is to find landlords who need an agent and persuade them to instruct us.



There’s no single method. We want someone who tries different channels, tracks what works and does more of it. You’ll be expected to use:



• OUR AGENT NETWORK – Build relationships with agents in our network’s UK offices so they refer landlords to us.



• TRADESPEOPLE & LOCAL BUSINESSES – Develop referral partnerships with builders, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, solicitors, mortgage brokers, accountants and removal firms.



• ONLINE LANDLORD SOURCES – Find landlords on platforms such as OpenRent and SpareRoom and contact those who could benefit from professional letting or property management services.



• LINKEDIN – Find and connect with landlords, investors and property professionals.



• YOUR OWN IDEAS – Come up with and test new ways of finding landlords, then share what works. We want someone who brings ideas rather than waiting for instructions.



You'll be working with the Managing Director who will handle in-person meetings and office visits. You’ll manage the day-to-day outreach between their visits and turn introductions into booked valuations.



DAILY OUTREACH TARGET



We expect approximately 100 tracked outreaches per day via
, phone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn or platform messages.



Consistent effort is essential to success in this role. Every outreach must be logged in our CRM, including replies, follow-ups and results.





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Carry out and log approximately 100 outreaches per day across the channels listed above.

• Follow up consistently until each contact has replied, referred a landlord or declined.

• Book valuations and meetings for me and our lettings team.

• Research landlord leads using public sources and add them to the pipeline.

• Prepare short messages, one-page offers and follow-up templates, using AI tools to help with drafting.

• Keep the CRM accurate and up to date.

• Send a weekly report covering outreaches by channel, replies, valuations booked, instructions won, what’s working and what you would change.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• Experience in real estate, property, sales or customer-facing business development. UK lettings experience is a major advantage.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to call and message UK professionals and landlords.

• Persistence and the ability to follow up without being pushy.

• Self-discipline to meet daily targets with minimal supervision.

• Willingness to learn the basics of UK lettings legislation, including the Tenant Fees Act and the Renters’ Rights Act.

• Reliable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability to work UK business hours.

• Good internet and ability to connect via Windows RDP to a computer based in the UK to work from.



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



• Experience using a CRM.

• Experience in outbound sales or lead generation.

• Experience in the luxury or international property market.

• Experience working in a startup or small team.



PAY & INCENTIVES



All payments are in USD and paid monthly in arrears by bank transfer.



FIXED BASE: $300 per month



PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES:

• $50 for each new let-only instruction.

• $75 for each new fully managed instruction.



HOW IT WORKS:

• Incentives are paid once the tenancy has started and the first rent has been received.

• Incentives apply to instructions generated through your own outreach and recorded in our CRM.

• There is no cap on the number of incentives you can earn.



EARNINGS EXAMPLE



In a month where you secure 4 let-only instructions and 2 fully managed instructions:



• Fixed base: $300

• 4 let-only instructions: $200

• 2 fully managed instructions: $150



TOTAL MONTHLY EARNINGS: $650



HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your CV and a short introduction video (maximum 3 minutes) to 



 SUBJECT: BDA LETTINGS



Applications without the introduction video will not be considered.



WHAT TO COVER IN YOUR VIDEO



Please answer the following questions:



• What experience do you have in real estate, sales or business development?

• How would you persuade an agent in another office to refer their landlord to us when they don’t know us yet?

• How would you find and approach landlords on OpenRent, SpareRoom and LinkedIn? What would you say to them?

• How would you build a referral network with tradespeople and local businesses? What would you offer them?

title: FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO CREATIVE EDITOR (LONG-TERM ROLE)

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us. It's one of the biggest drivers of the whole business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time, remote role (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

title: Senior Video-editor
description:
We are a Dutch D2C brand based in the Netherlands. We run paid video ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) for the Dutch and Belgian market. Our creatives are built around strategic concepts, and every video has one job: grab attention, hold it, and turn viewers into customers.

We're looking for a Senior Video Editor who doesn't just cut clips together, but understands why a video works.



Who We're Looking For

Someone who understands how people actually watch ads on Meta: thumb on the screen, sound often off, ready to scroll away at any second. You know how to structure a video so the viewer stays, from the first frame to the CTA.

Ideally, you can look at a script and tell us: "This part will lose people. Let's move the payoff up," or "This hook is too slow, try this instead." We value editors who bring their own ideas and actively look for ways to make our ads better.



This is NOT a role for YouTube editors, vlog editors or wedding/event editors. We need someone with real experience in performance ads for D2C brands. So if you don't have experience with D2C, do not apply. 



What You'll Do

- Edit high-converting AI UGC videos and B-roll-driven ads for Meta (Reels, Stories, Feed)

- Structure videos for maximum retention: hook → problem → proof → solution → CTA

- Create scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

- Build clear, strong CTAs that drive action

- Create and source B-roll using AI tools and stock libraries



Produce videos with our AI stack:

- Higgsfield for AI video and visuals

- HeyGen for AI avatars and UGC-style talking heads

- Use Claude for optimising visual prompts



Give feedback on scripts: where they're too slow, unclear or weak

Create multiple variations per concept for testing (different hooks, angles and CTAs)

Add captions, motion graphics, sound design and pacing optimized for sound-off viewing



Requirements (Must-Have)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing Meta ads for D2C / e-commerce brands. This is non-negotiable.

- A portfolio with real paid ads you've edited (Meta or TikTok ads, not organic or YouTube content)

- Deep understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling and CTAs in short-form ads

- Experience with AI UGC and comfort with tools like Higgsfield, HeyGen and ElevenLabs

- Comfortable editing videos in Dutch. You don't need to speak it, but you must work accurately with Dutch scripts, voiceovers and captions (we'll provide translations).

Nice to Have

- Experience with health, wellness or 45+ target audiences

- Copywriting skills for hooks and on-screen text

- Experience working with European brands

- Understanding of ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR) and how editing affects them



What We Offer

- Long-term, stable position with a growing Dutch brand

- Work with the latest AI video tools

- Your ideas are heard. We want you to think along, not just execute.

- Room to grow into a lead creative role



How to Apply

Send us:
