title: Media Buyer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.



This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.

For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll d
 the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.



Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.



Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.



Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.



Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.



Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.



Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.



Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.



Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Campaigns go live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your decisions move the numbers.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the buyer who runs our growth channel is the buyer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Instagram Carousel Copywriter
description:
# Instagram carousel copywriter 



We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more.



**This role is carousels. That's it.** Not email sequences. Not landing pages. Not blogs. Not single-image posts with a clever caption. We're hiring someone who specializes in multi-slide Instagram carousels and has the receipts to prove it.



Carousels are their own format with their own rules. Slide one has to earn slide two, slide two has to earn slide three, every break is a decision, and the last slide has to convert attention you spent nine slides building. Writing one good line is not the job. Holding a reader across ten of them is.



## The job



Daily carousels for Bruno. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post.



- Daily carousels in Bruno's voice, hook slide through CTA slide

- Structure that holds the swipe: one idea per slide, breaks that pull, no dead middle

- Hooks that stop the scroll, closing slides that get DMs

- QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines

- Brief the designers so slide copy and slide design aren't fighting each other

- Track swipe-through, saves, shares, and DMs — what hits, what flops, what gets flagged — and fix the system off it

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic



Reels may come later once you've got the voice down, but carousels are the job and carousels are what we'll judge the work on.



## Who we want



Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs.



You should have:



- **A carousel portfolio.** Actual multi-slide posts you wrote, ideally for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement. Send slides, not tweets.

- **Run an actual Instagram account day to day.** You've watched your own carousels save and die, and you can explain why.

- **Copy you'd defend.** You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it.

- **A marketer's eye.** Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell.

- **AI already in your workflow.** You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you.



Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice.



## Who we're not looking for



Being direct so nobody wastes a day on the task:



- *
 marketers.** Sequences are a real craft. It isn't this one.

- **Single-slide / static post writers.** One graphic and a caption is a different skill.

- **Landing page, blog, SEO, or ad copywriters** looking to cross over into social.

- **Generalists** whose portfolio is mostly the above with a couple of carousels at the bottom.



If that's you, you're probably great at what you do. You're just not who we're after here.



## Two things we won't budge on



The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this.



Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday.



## How to apply



No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way.



**1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and the carousels you've written for creators or brands.



**2. The task.**



Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile (
), research the account, and pitch 5 carousel ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts.



Example:



> Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

>

> Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays).



Part 2: Write out 2 of those 5 as full carousels, slide by slide, as many slides as the idea needs. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too.



You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over.



Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.

title: Recruitment Sourcer and QA Tester
description:
About us



Skreen.ai is a UK technology company. Our platform helps employers screen and interview job applicants faster, using AI. We are a small team, and this is a new role that will grow with us.



The role



You will find great candidates for the jobs our customers need to fill, and help us test our software. The roles you source for will vary: sales, marketing, software development and more.



You will start with a mix of sourcing and software testing. Over time the job focus becomes mainly sourcing. We will train you on our tools and process, one tool at a time.



What you will do



Candidate sourcing



- Search UK and US job board CV databases (such as Indeed, Reed, CV-Library and Totaljobs) and LinkedIn for candidates who match a job, by job title, skills, location and recent activity.

- Build a shortlist of strong candidates for each role (often 50 to 100 profiles), checked against the job's requirements.

- Find verified work contact details using contact-finding tools.

- Write short, personal outreach messages and follow-ups to candidates, saying where you found them and how they can opt out.

- Record every candidate you source in our system: which job, which board, the date, and that you found them.



Software testing (QA)



- Test new features and bug fixes in our web app before they are released.

- Find bugs and write clear bug reports: what you did, what you expected, what happened, with screenshots.

- Re-test fixes, and check that old features still work.



What we are looking for



Must have



- Excellent written and spoken English. You will write to UK candidates every day.

- Strong problem-solving and attention to detail.

- Your own reliable computer, a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work.

- Available full time, 40 hours a week, with at least [4] hours overlapping UK business hours (9am to 5:30pm UK time).

- Comfortable following strict rules on handling personal data.

- A verified ID on onlinejobs.ph.



Nice to have



- Experience sourcing or recruiting, especially for UK or US companies.

- Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Reed, CV-Library, Totaljobs, Apollo or similar tools.

- Experience in manual software testing or QA, and with Jira.

- Experience writing outreach or sales
s.



You do not need recruiting experience if you are a fast learner with excellent English. We will train you.



Pay and hours



- USD $800 to $1,200 a month, depending on your experience.

- Full time, 40 hours a week.

- We provide paid access to all the tools you need.

We are looking for an experienced WordPress and Webflow Developer to rebuild an existing

WordPress website in Webflow, while implementing requested design and functionality

modifications.



This role requires someone who is already highly proficient in both WordPress and Webflow

and can independently execute the project with minimal guidance. We are specifically looking

for an expert who can confidently assess the existing website, determine the best approach for

rebuilding it, and deliver a polished Webflow site.

functionality in Webflow.

recommendations.

• Conduct thorough testing before launch.



Requirements

• Proven expert-level experience with Webflow.

• Strong experience developing and customizing WordPress websites.

• Demonstrated experience rebuilding or migrating websites from WordPress to Webflow.

• Strong understanding of responsive web design.

• Ability to accurately recreate existing websites while improving layouts and functionality

where requested.

• Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS; JavaScript knowledge is a plus.

• Excellent attention to detail.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of the project.

• Able to understand requirements and execute without needing extensive training or

hand-holding.



Non-Negotiable

We are looking for an expert who already knows how to do this—not someone who will need

to figure out Webflow or learn the process while working on the project.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Webflow CMS.

• Experience with website migrations and redirects/SEO preservation.

• Opportunity to take on greater ownership and managerial responsibility as the digital team grows

title: Video Editor & Creator
description:
Calling All Video Editors!

 

Do you speak and write excellent English? Are you looking for a stable, full-time role with a USA-based company? Our Filipino team members have been with us for years, and we'd love for you to be next.

 

Do you love turning raw footage into engaging stories? Are you skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a sharp eye for detail? If so, we want YOU on our team!

 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We're looking for a talented and enthusiastic Video Editor to join our growing team. You'll edit long-form video podcasts for YouTube channels run by medical professionals, covering health topics such as joint pain, sports medicine, regenerative treatments and men's health.

 

You'll work closely with an established production team that offers clear communication and support. Even so, we need an independent problem-solver. You should be able to take raw video and audio, handle post-production from start to finish, and deliver on time without needing reminders or close supervision.

 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

- Video and audio editing: Edit raw podcast recordings into polished long-form YouTube videos using Adobe Premiere Pro. Cut filler words, dead air and awkward pauses. Clean up background noise and balance audio levels so every episode sounds crisp and professional.

- Visual enhancements: Add b-roll, captions and simple graphics that follow brand guidelines.

- Thumbnail design: Create eye-catching, high-converting thumbnails that drive clicks.

- AI-assisted optimization: Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to write SEO-friendly titles, descriptions and tags, following the team's templates.

- Accuracy: Make sure medical terms are spelled correctly in captions, titles and descriptions.

- Channel management: Upload videos, manage playlists and handle the YouTube back end so each channel runs smoothly.

- Delivery and revisions: Upload deliverables to Dropbox, submit them for review before the deadline, and make revisions based on feedback.

- Team collaboration: Coordinate daily with the team on files, workflows and publishing schedules, and submit an End-of-Day report.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro (other editing software such as DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut is a plus)

- Solid audio editing skills (EQ, compression, noise reduction)

- Familiarity with AI tools for writing titles, descriptions and other content

- Thumbnail design skills in Photoshop, Canva or similar software

- Basic understanding of YouTube Studio, SEO and analytics

- Comfortable working with medical and health content (a healthcare background or interest is a plus)

- Highly reliable: manages time well, meets deadlines consistently and communicates proactively

- Detail-oriented, organized and open to feedback

- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos or podcasts is a plus, but we're willing to train the right person

 

 

EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS

 

- A PC or laptop that can handle video editing:

   - Intel Core i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7 (newer generations preferred)

   - At least 16GB of RAM

   - At least 1TB of storage

   - Dedicated graphics card (optional)

- A fast, reliable internet connection for uploading and downloading large video files

- A backup power source

 

 

SCHEDULE

 

Full-time, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM US Eastern Time (11:00 PM - 7:00 AM Philippine Time)

 

 

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 

- Base salary: PHP 40,000 per month

- Quarterly bonus: PHP 20,000 every 3 months (in place of the 13th month pay)

- Paid time off: Includes paid leave and select Philippine holidays, such as All Saints' Day

 

 

WHY JOIN US?

 

We help a lot of people, and you'll be an important part of that work. We currently have 14 full-time, permanent team members in the Philippines, and we treat each of them like pamilya, with respect and appreciation.

 

As a thank-you to our Filipino team, we've hosted all-expense-paid trips for two (travel, food and 5-star lodging such as Henann Resorts), including:

 

- 2022: Boracay

- 2023: Alona Beach, Bohol

- April 2024: El Nido, Palawan

________________________________________

ARE YOU HIGHLY ORGANISED, GREAT WITH NUMBERS AND OBSESSED WITH DETAILS?

If you are the person who notices the small things that everyone else misses, keeps spreadsheets perfectly organised, follows up when something hasn't been completed, and takes pride in getting things right the first time, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for an exceptional Bookkeeper & Property Operations Coordinator to join our growing UK property management business.

Complete the Application Form:

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

We are a growing company, so the right person can grow with us.

________________________________________

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a UK-based residential lettings and property management company working with landlords and tenants across South East England.

We are looking for someone who combines:

Bookkeeping + Administration + Property Coordination + Project Coordination

You will support the Director and wider team across the financial and operational side of the business.

The role requires someone who is extremely organised, reliable and comfortable working independently.

You will need to be able to look at a task, understand what needs to happen, take ownership of it and make sure it gets completed.

________________________________________

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

BOOKKEEPING & FINANCE

Approximately 5 hours per week initially will be dedicated to bookkeeping and financial administration.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Recording and checking financial transactions

• Maintaining accurate financial records

• Updating spreadsheets

• Checking invoices

• Matching invoices to payments and work completed

• Monitoring rent and payment information

• Following up outstanding financial information

• Preparing information for the company's accountant

• Checking supplier invoices

• Recording property-related expenses

• Maintaining organised digital financial files

• Identifying discrepancies or missing information

• Supporting basic financial reporting

• Helping maintain accurate cash-flow information

Accuracy is extremely important.

We would rather have someone who carefully checks their work than someone who works quickly but makes mistakes.

________________________________________

PROPERTY & OPERATIONS COORDINATION

You will also help coordinate the day-to-day operation of our property management business.

This may include:

• Coordinating property maintenance and repairs

• Following up contractors and suppliers

• Tracking outstanding property tasks

• Coordinating property preparation between tenancies

• Monitoring vacant properties

• Helping reduce property void periods

• Maintaining compliance records

• Updating property management systems

• Checking that tasks have been completed

• Supporting tenant and landlord administration

• Organising documents

• Maintaining Google Drive

• Updating Asana

• Supporting the Director with administrative tasks

• Coordinating the work of other team members

• Preparing reports and spreadsheets

You will be expected to follow things through to completion.

If you send someone a message asking for an invoice, for example, your responsibility does not end when the message is sent.

You will follow up until the invoice is received, checked, recorded and filed.

________________________________________

PROCESS & SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT

This is an important part of the role.

We are continuously improving the way we operate.

You will help us:

• Create process workflows

• Document existing processes

• Create Operational Manuals

• Improve Standard Operating Procedures

• Create checklists

• Identify inefficiencies

• Improve administration systems

• Create workflows in L

• Organise information in Google Drive

• Improve our use of Asana and property management software

• Identify opportunities to systemise or automate repetitive tasks

You don't need to know everything when you start.

You do need to be someone who enjoys learning and improving things.

________________________________________

THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role is particularly suited to someone who has experience in:

• Bookkeeping

• Property management

• Lettings

• Administration

• Operations

• Project coordination

• Executive assistance

• Finance administration

You don't necessarily need experience in every area.

What matters most is that you are:

EXTREMELY DETAIL-ORIENTATED

You notice discrepancies.

You check your work.

You don't assume something is correct simply because someone else entered it.

You understand that a small mistake in bookkeeping or property management can create a much bigger problem later.

ORGANISED

You know what needs to be done, when it needs to be done and what is still outstanding.

PROACTIVE

You don't constantly wait to be told what to do.

If you see something that needs attention, you raise it.

If you can solve a problem yourself, you do so.

RELIABLE

When you say something will be completed, we expect it to be completed.

GOOD WITH NUMBERS

A GOOD COMMUNICATOR

A PROBLEM SOLVER

You look for solutions rather than simply reporting problems.

A FAST LEARNER

You are comfortable learning new software, systems and processes.

SOMEONE WHO TAKES OWNERSHIP

We are looking for someone who thinks:

"I will take care of this."

rather than:

"That isn't my responsibility."

________________________________________

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE

You should have:

PROPERTY EXPERIENCE IS A STRONG ADVANTAGE

SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE

________________________________________

WHAT WE VALUE

HONESTY

We are trusted with people's homes, money and businesses.

We expect honesty at all times.

ATTENTION TO DETAIL

We care about doing things properly.

OWNERSHIP

We take responsibility for our work and our mistakes.

PROACTIVITY

CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

POSITIVE ATTITUDE

WHAT WE OFFER

FLEXIBLE REMOTE WORK

title: Senior Customer Operations Specialist – SAP Order Management (Wholesale)
description:
Interviews are being held Mon 12 – Wed 14 Oct, so please apply by Sunday 11 Oct.



Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | USD $250 per week | Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:00pm Australian Eastern Time (AET)



Daytime hours in the Philippines: approx. 6:00am–2:00pm PHT during Australian daylight saving (Oct–Apr), 7:00am–3:00pm PHT otherwise. No night shift.



A leading international apparel and headwear brand is hiring an experienced Customer Operations Specialist for its wholesale customer-service team.



You'll own wholesale orders from receipt to delivery in SAP, keep customers informed, and work with sales, logistics, warehouse and finance so every order is accurate and on time. This is a senior role. We want someone who takes ownership, builds their own reports, and can guide or back up others in the team.



What you'll do

- Enter, change and manage wholesale customer orders in SAP, from order entry through delivery and invoicing

- Process and monitor EDI orders, and fix failed or rejected transactions

- Track open orders, deliveries, backorders and stock delays

- Build and maintain open-order and delivery-status reports in Excel

- Update wholesale customers on orders and deliveries before issues become problems

- Resolve order discrepancies, short shipments, damaged goods and delivery issues

- Provide invoices, PODs and order acknowledgements

- Process returns in line with company policy

- Handle product, pricing and account enquiries, and troubleshoot B2B platform issues

- Work closely with sales, sourcing, logistics, warehouse and finance

- Support and train other team members on processes and systems

- Help with eCommerce order enquiries when needed



Must-haves

- Fluent spoken and written English (non-negotiable)

- 3+ years in order processing, customer operations or wholesale customer service

- Hands-on SAP sales order processing: order entry and changes, deliveries, billing and invoicing. Warehouse-only or inventory-only SAP experience is not enough

- Advanced Excel: XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and building open-order and delivery reports

- Experience in wholesale, retail, FMCG, fashion or distribution

- Organised, detail-focused and proactive, and able to manage multiple deadlines without being chased

- Able to work Mon–Fri, 9:00am–5:00pm AET, consistently



Strongly preferred

- EDI order management (receiving, monitoring and fixing EDI orders)

- Experience leading, training or acting as backup for a small team

- Apparel, footwear or headwear industry experience



Performance expectations

- 97% or better order accuracy

- Orders entered within 48 hours of receipt

- Enquiries answered within 24 hours

- Delivery delays communicated before the due date

- Warehouse amendments handled promptly

- Full ownership of issues from start to resolution



How to apply

Answer every question below in your application. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.

1. Attach your updated CV.

2. How many years have you used SAP to process sales orders, and when did you last use it? List the SAP transactions or functions you used regularly.

3. Describe one Excel report you built to track orders or deliveries, and the formulas or functions you used.

4. Have you led, trained or supervised other people? Give the team size and context.

5. Describe your EDI experience, if any. What did you personally handle?

6. What is your earliest start date? Confirm you can work Mon–Fri, 9:00am–5:00pm AET (6:00am–2:00pm PHT during Australian daylight saving), at USD $250 per week.



Fluent English is required

title: Meta Ads Manager + VSL Video Creator: Motorsport App (Australia)
description:
About us



Purple Sector is a web app for track-day drivers, racers and karters in Australia. A driver uploads the data file from their lap timer or logger (MyChron, AiM, VBOX, RaceBox and more), and our AI coach shows them which corners are costing them time and what to try next session. We sell credit packs and a monthly Coach plan. Most new drivers find us through Meta ads (Instagram and
).



What you'll do



- Run our Meta ads account. Plan, build, launch and test campaigns, ad sets and ads. Read the results, kill what doesn't work, and grow what does.

- Make the ads. Short VSL-style videos (talking-head or voiceover, hook, problem, the app in action, call to action) and static ads. Record the app yourself from our demo account. You can use any tools you like, AI included, as long as it looks good and tells the truth.

- Write the copy. Hooks, primary text, headlines.

- Post organically. Repurpose the best ads as Reels and posts on our Instagram and TikTok.

- Suggest landing page tests. Ideas for headlines and pages; we build them.

- Report weekly. Spend, sign-ups, drivers who analysed a lap, paying customers, best and worst ads, and next week's tests.



How we work



- Every video and ad is approved by the owner before it goes live (a simple approvals board in Notion).

- You get partner access to the ad account (Advertiser role) and run tests within an agreed daily budget. Bigger budgets or new offers are agreed first.

- Honest advertising only: no promised lap-time gains, no fake reviews, and no claiming results the app can't show.

- A Notion workspace for your work, notes and reports.



Pay



- US$400–500/month base, depending on experience.

- Monthly KPI bonus: US$100 in any month your ads bring in 20 or more new paying customers (any purchase counts; refunds don't). Measured by our own tracking.

- A short paid test task (US$20) before we hire.



What we're looking for



- Proven experience running Meta ads for a product (app, SaaS or e-commerce). Tell us real numbers: spend, CPA or ROAS.

- Strong short-form video editing with a sense for hooks and pacing. Examples required.

- Good written English for ad copy.

- Organised and reliable; you document what you test and why.

- Big bonus: you're into cars, motorsport, karting or sim racing.



How to apply



Reply with:

1. "Purple Sector ads" in the first line, so we know you read this far.

2. 2–3 links to ads or short videos you made, and what result each one got.

3. One Meta campaign you ran: product, monthly spend, and the result (CPA, ROAS or similar).

4. A one-line hook you'd test for an app that shows track-day drivers where they lose time.

5. Your available hours in AEST.



Applications without examples won't be considered.

title: AppLovin Ads Specialist (Ecommerce / Shopify Brands)
description:
Have YOU actually scaled an ecommerce store on AppLovin (Axon Ads Manager) and can you prove it with real numbers? Can you look at a video creative and immediately tell whether it will survive in a mobile in-app environment, where the user never asked to see an ad? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run ecommerce brands in international markets and we're looking for an **AppLovin Ads Specialist** with proven ecommerce results to launch and scale this channel for us.



## We need someone to take responsibility for:



**Launching AppLovin for Ecommerce:** Set up the account structure, campaign architecture, budgets, and bidding strategy (purchase / ROAS optimization) for a Shopify-based ecommerce store. You know what to test first, how to scale what works, and when to cut what doesn't.



**Tracking & Attribution:** AppLovin attribution is not as clean as search. You will set up and verify the pixel / event tracking, make sure purchase events are firing correctly, and cross-check AppLovin-reported numbers against Shopify and our other sources, so we always know what is real and what is inflated.



**Creative Direction for In-App Environments:** Short-form video (typically 15-30 seconds), fast hooks, one message, one CTA. You will brief our creative team on what works on AppLovin specifically, and guide testing of hooks, formats, and variations. You don't need to edit videos yourself, but you must know exactly what a winning AppLovin ad looks like.



**Testing & Optimization:** Run structured creative and audience tests, read the data correctly, and make clear decisions about budget allocation.



**Weekly Performance Review:** A short weekly call walking us through spend, ROAS/CPA, what was tested, what we learned, and what's next. We want to see the numbers move.



## Position Requirements:



**Proven AppLovin experience on ecommerce accounts.** You must have personally managed AppLovin campaigns for ecommerce brands (Shopify or similar, selling physical or digital products directly to consumers). Mobile gaming / app install experience alone does not qualify. Lead generation, pay-per-call, or non-ecommerce work does not count.



**Results you can show.** In the application form you will be asked to share a Google Drive folder with everything that proves your results: dashboards, spend and ROAS/CPA screenshots, before/after comparisons, case studies, client feedback. Sensitive client data can be blurred, but the numbers must be visible. No proof, no interview.



**Strong tracking knowledge:** Comfortable diagnosing event tracking, attribution discrepancies, and pixel issues across AppLovin, Shopify, and analytics tools.



**Creative sense for performance:** You understand what makes a short video convert in a low-intent, in-app environment and can give precise, actionable feedback.



**Honest, data-first mindset:** We value someone who tells us "this channel isn't working yet, here's why and here's the plan" over someone who hides bad numbers.



**Fluent in English:** The team communicates in English.



**Availability:** This is a **part-time, ongoing collaboration**: roughly 1 hour/day on average, more during launch phases, plus one weekly review call. We also need someone reachable for real emergencies on weekends (broken tracking, budget issues, disapproved campaigns). This is not a daily weekend commitment, but when something critical breaks, you respond.



## What We Offer:



**Ongoing Retainer:** Hourly / weekly retainer based on the scope above, with room to grow as spend scales.



**Real Ownership:** You own AppLovin end-to-end for our ecommerce brands, not just execute someone else's brief.



**Results-Based Relationship:** If the numbers are good, this becomes a long-term, expanding engagement with budgets that grow alongside results.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (AI B-ROLL AND CHARACTERS)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



NEURAL

title: AI STATIC AD DESIGNER
description:
AI STATIC AD DESIGNER

Full-Time | Remote 



We run paid ads on Meta every single day.

We are looking for someone who produces static ads at volume using AI.

Not a traditional graphic designer.

Not a creative strategist.

We come up with the concepts. You turn them into images.



WHAT YOU’D DO

* Take a winning ad and create dozens of versions of it.

* Keep the core message while changing hooks, layouts, colours, imagery and visual treatments.

* Take new concepts we give you and turn them into finished static ads.

* Work from an idea, script and reference while d
 how the execution should look.

* Build offer ads such as buy-one-get-one, percentage discounts, free gift stacks and price comparisons.

* Produce hundreds of images every month.

* Make variations quickly without unnecessarily changing the concept.

Nobody hand-designs that volume of creative from scratch.



You need an AI-first workflow.



THE TOOLS YOU NEED TO ALREADY KNOW



You should already know how to work with:

* Nano Banana Pro

* Midjourney

* Higgsfield

* Photoshop or Figma for assembly

We provide the tools and credits once you are hired.

We are not teaching someone AI image generation from scratch.



WHO THIS IS FOR



This role is for you if:

* You generate images rather than manually building everything from scratch.

* You have created ads that actually ran on paid traffic.

* You can take one idea and produce twenty different executions without getting bored.

* You follow the brief.

* If we ask for the same message five ways, you give us five executions of that message, not five completely different concepts.

* You have good visual taste but understand that the ad exists to perform, not become a portfolio piece.

* You can produce at volume without being chased.

* You are comfortable doing repeated variations of winning ideas.



DO NOT APPLY IF

* Your experience is mainly branding, logos or organic social media posts.

* You have never made an ad that ran on paid Meta traffic.

* You want to be the person coming up with the concepts.

* You are still learning AI image-generation tools.

* You dislike repetitive iteration.

* You want to reinvent the brief every time.

* You need somebody constantly telling you what to do next.



THE SETUP

* Full-time

* Long-term

* Remote

* Work your own hours as long as deadlines are hit and you are responsive during agreed working windows

* AI tools and credits are provided

* Performance-based upside is available for ads that scale

* Compensation is discussed after the interview based on experience, output and the type of work you can handle



PAY

Compensation is discussed after the interview.



The final compensation will depend on your experience, output, and the level of work you can take on.



There is also additional performance-based upside tied to ads you create that scale, with room for compensation to grow over time based on performance and output.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send us a CV or a traditional portfolio.



IF YOU WANNA BE CONSIDERED, SEND A LOOM VIDEO 3-5 MINUTES LONG.



In the Loom:

1. Show us three to five static ads you personally worked on that actually ran on paid traffic.

2. Tell us exactly what your part was on each one.

3. Show us something you created using AI.

4. Walk us through your workflow and which tools you used.

5. If you have access to performance data such as spend, ROAS or CTR, show us. If you do not, just say so.

6. Tell us approximately how much static creative you can realistically produce in a normal month.

No slides.



Show us the actual work and talk us through it.



Applications without a Loom will AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED. FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS. READ THE JOB POST PROPERLY.



Shortlisted applicants will move to a paid practical trial using real creative from our account.



Send your Loom link in your application with a link to your portfolio!

title: DTC Creative Strategist & Direct-Response Copywriter — AI Ads for Supplement Brands
description:
We’re looking for a creative strategist and direct-response copywriter with proven experience creating paid social ads for supplement, health or wellness brands.



Most of our creative will be AI-generated or AI-assisted. We need someone who can combine customer research, persuasive copy and strong visual thinking to develop concepts that make the most of these formats.



You’ll work directly with me to shape our creative strategy and turn customer insights into ads we can produce, test and improve.



Our editors will handle production. Your job is to give them a strong concept, a persuasive script and a clear brief — then take ownership of the creative through to final review.



What You’ll Own



Researching customer motivations, pain points, objections and buying triggers.



Developing distinct angles for different customer avatars and awareness levels.



Writing hooks and scripts for Meta ads, including UGC-style creative, educational ads, problem-solution stories and longer-form direct response.



Developing concepts specifically suited to AI production.



Giving editors clear direction on visuals, pacing, demonstrations and emotional beats.



Reviewing finished ads to make sure the execution delivers on the concept.



Using campaign results to d
 what to iterate, expand or replace.



Building a clear record of creative tests and what we learn from them.



We want someone who can own the thinking behind an ad and carry that thinking through execution.



Who We’re Looking For



Non-negotiables



Proven direct-response copywriting or creative strategy experience for DTC brands.



Relevant work in supplements, health or wellness.



A portfolio of paid social ads with a clear explanation of your contribution.



Strong understanding of hooks, awareness levels, objections, mechanisms, proof and offers.



Ability to turn customer research into specific, original creative angles.



Strong visual instincts and experience briefing editors or designers.



Understanding of supplement advertising constraints, including accurate claims and responsible use of testimonials.



Ability to interpret performance data and turn it into useful creative decisions.



Clear communication, reliable delivery and ownership of your work.



Experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure ecommerce brands is a strong plus. We’re especially interested in the quality of your thinking and the work you personally contributed.



The Mindset



We’re looking for someone who is:



Highly motivated to improve.



Curious about why people buy.



Proactive about bringing new ideas.



Comfortable defending a creative decision and changing their mind when the evidence points elsewhere.



Open to direct feedback.



Able to move quickly while maintaining a high standard.



Interested in becoming an exceptional direct-response marketer.



You should enjoy having responsibility for what we test next.



What Great Looks Like



A strong strategist can trace a concept back to a real customer insight.



You understand what the viewer already believes, what they need to understand and what might stop them from buying. You use that understanding to build the hook, structure the script and guide the visuals.



Before handing a concept to an editor, you should be thinking about:



Who is this ad speaking to?



What makes the opening relevant enough to stop them scrolling?



What is the central idea?



Why should the viewer believe it?



Which objection needs to be addressed?



What should we show to make the message easier to understand?



Does the product follow naturally from the story?



What are we trying to learn from this test?



Every brief should make the creative direction clear while giving the editor room to contribute.



AI Creative Strategy



AI ads will make up most of the work in this role.



You should be comfortable developing ideas across formats such as:



AI spokesperson and UGC-style ads.



Educational explainers and animations.



Product-focused scenes and demonstrations.



Story-led concepts featuring generated characters.



Visual metaphors that make complex ideas easier to understand.



AI-generated B-roll and attention-grabbing opening scenes.



You don’t need to be the person generating every asset. You do need to understand the possibilities and limitations well enough to write concepts our editors can execute convincingly.



Familiarity with tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling is a plus.



Good judgment matters here. Concepts must stay grounded in supportable product claims, and generated characters must never be presented as real customers giving genuine testimonials.



Output & Working Rhythm



A consistent pipeline of researched concepts and production-ready scripts.



Clear briefs that help editors move efficiently.



Fast, specific feedback on finished creative.



Regular review of performance and testing priorities.



A balance of new angles and thoughtful iterations on existing concepts.



We’ll agree on weekly output expectations based on the scope and complexity of the work. We care about a repeatable process that delivers both quality and speed.



Working Directly With Me



I’m looking for someone I can build a close creative working relationship with.



We’ll discuss the products, customers, positioning and results together. I want you to bring a point of view, flag weak ideas early and suggest better directions.



As you develop a deeper understanding of the brands, I want you to take increasing ownership of creative planning and execution.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating across the UK accountancy profession. We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment company, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Resourcer to play a central role in that growth.



This is not an administrative resourcing position, and it is not a role for someone who waits to be given a daily list of tasks. We need an exceptionally proactive, intelligent and commercially aware individual who naturally takes ownership, spots opportunities and makes things happen.



The successful person must take complete responsibility for every task and agreed action, progressing it promptly and following it through to its proper conclusion without needing to be chased. Sending an initial message, beginning a piece of research or simply reporting an opportunity will not, by itself, be regarded as completing the task. We need somebody who remains responsible until the intended outcome has been achieved, properly recorded and clearly communicated.



You will work closely with the business owner, supporting him by generating high-quality candidate conversations, identifying recruitment opportunities and progressing those opportunities as far as possible. You will undertake sourcing, research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up, allowing the business owner to become the senior touchpoint with candidates and clients at the most commercially important stages.



The right person will be able to take a small piece of market information and turn it into a structured commercial plan. For example, if you discover that an accountancy firm is recruiting, you will not simply report that information. You will research the firm, identify the relevant decision-makers, understand its likely recruitment requirements, recommend an appropriate engagement strategy and take proactive steps to create a conversation, meeting or commercial opportunity.



You must be resourceful, progressive and comfortable working with significant independence. Success will be measured through conversations, meetings, candidates, opportunities and commercial outcomes—not simply by the number of tasks started or messages sent.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and engagement



• Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals who may be suitable for current or future opportunities.

• Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, disciplines and levels of seniority.

• Create persuasive, highly personalised approaches that generate genuine candidate interest.

• Engage professionally with potential candidates through appropriate online platforms, email, telephone and other suitable channels.

• Follow up intelligently and persistently without requiring reminders or continual direction.

• Conduct initial candidate qualification conversations to establish experience, qualifications, location, salary, notice period, career aspirations and reasons for considering a move.

• Obtain current CVs and relevant background information before booking candidates to speak with the business owner.

• Schedule qualified candidate meetings directly into the business owner’s diary.

• Maintain relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

• Ask candidates for referrals and use market intelligence to identify further opportunities.

• Ensure candidate records, communications and activity notes are accurately maintained within the CRM.

• Continue progressing candidate relationships until an appropriate outcome or agreed follow-up position has been reached.



Market intelligence and opportunity creation



• Monitor the UK accountancy recruitment market and identify firms that are recruiting, growing, acquiring other businesses or likely to require recruitment support.

• Turn small pieces of information into practical, commercially focused action plans.

• Research prospective clients, including their structure, locations, vacancies, decision-makers and potential recruitment challenges.

• Develop tailored engagement approaches for individual firms rather than relying on generic messages.

• Initiate contact and work towards generating introductory meetings for the business owner.

• Recognise commercial opportunities arising from candidate conversations and market research.

• Progress every credible lead promptly rather than merely recording or reporting it.

• Follow commercial opportunities through until the intended action has been completed or a clear outcome has been achieved.

• Recommend new searches, campaigns, talent pools and market opportunities based on the information you uncover.

• Work collaboratively with the Marketing Manager to convert campaigns, responses and market visibility into candidate and client conversations.

• Identify obstacles affecting results, recommend solutions and adjust the approach when necessary.



Supporting the business owner



• Become a highly dependable extension of the business owner.

• Anticipate what needs to happen next and take appropriate action without waiting to be instructed.

• Protect the business owner’s time by completing research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up before involving him.

• Provide concise, useful information that enables fast commercial decisions.

• Prepare the business owner thoroughly for candidate and client meetings.

• Follow up agreed actions immediately after meetings and ensure opportunities continue moving forward.

• Bring forward ideas, solutions and recommended actions—not simply questions or problems.

• Take responsibility for filling the business owner’s diary with worthwhile candidate and prospective-client conversations.

• Take complete ownership of assigned tasks and agreed actions, ensuring they are progressed promptly and followed through to full completion without requiring reminders.

• Remain responsible for each piece of work from the initial instruction through to the intended outcome.

• Proactively resolve obstacles and communicate promptly if additional information, authority or support is genuinely required.

• Never regard a task as complete simply because the first action has been taken; ensure the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.

• Maintain a reliable system for monitoring every commitment, deadline and follow-up so that nothing is overlooked or allowed to lose 
ntum.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant must be:



• Extremely proactive: You naturally take action, follow through and continually look for the next opportunity.

• Accountable and completion-focused: You take personal ownership of every task and agreed action, follow it through to its proper conclusion and can be trusted to deliver without being chased.

• Commercially minded: You understand that the purpose of your work is to generate conversations, relationships, vacancies and placements.

• Resourceful: You can take limited information, research it properly and turn it into something commercially valuable.

• Highly independent: You can manage your workload and generate productive activity without constant supervision.

• Persistent: You follow up appropriately and do not allow worthwhile opportunities to disappear through lack of action.

• Intelligent and analytical: You can interpret information, identify connections and d
 on the most effective next step.

• An exceptional communicator: Your spoken and written English must be of an outstanding professional standard.

• Confident: You must be comfortable communicating with experienced UK professionals and senior business decision-makers.

• Organised: You can manage multiple searches, follow-ups, candidate relationships and commercial leads without losing 
ntum.

• Dependable: If you commit to completing something, the business owner can trust that it will be completed properly, on time and to the required standard.

• Adaptable: You respond positively to changing priorities and a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

• Outcome-focused: You measure your success through tangible results rather than general activity.



Essential requirements



• Educated to degree level.

• Exceptional written and spoken English.

• Previous experience in recruitment sourcing, executive search, candidate generation, lead generation, business development or another relevant commercially focused role.

• Demonstrable experience of working independently and creating opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions.

• Evidence of taking ownership of work and following tasks through to full completion.

• Strong online research and market-mapping ability.

• Confidence in initiating professional conversations by telephone, email and other communication channels.

• Ability to write persuasive and highly personalised outreach.

• Experience using a CRM or similar database system.

• Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

• A reliable, high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.

• Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Local working hours will change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.



Performance measures



Success in this role will be assessed through measurable commercial outcomes, including:



• Qualified candidate conversations generated.

• Candidate meetings booked and attended.

• High-quality candidates introduced against live and prospective vacancies.

• Updated CVs and candidate information obtained.

• Candidate relationships developed and reactivated.

• Recruitment leads and prospective clients identified.

• Introductory client meetings created.

• Quality and personalisation of outreach.

• Speed and consistency of follow-up.

• Completion of tasks and agreed actions without reminders.

• Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

• Evidence of independent ideas, initiative and commercial ownership.

• Ability to turn limited information into valuable candidate or client opportunities.

• Contribution to the continued growth of the business.



What this role is not



This is not a general virtual assistant, data-entry or purely administrative position. It is not suitable for somebody who needs every task to be explained, waits for instructions or regards sending a message or beginning a task as the finished outcome.

We are looking for someone who asks:

“What commercial opportunity can I create from this information, what should happen next, and what can I do now to move it forward?”

The successful person will be ambitious, energetic and determined to become a key contributor to the development of a substantial UK recruitment business. This is an opportunity to work closely with an experienced recruitment business owner, take genuine responsibility and build a role with considerable long-term scope.



Engagement details



This is a full-time, self-employed independent contractor opportunity. The successful applicant will not be employed directly by Garry Howling Recruitment and will be responsible for managing and paying their own tax, statutory contributions, insurance and any other obligations arising in their country of residence.



The contractor will be expected to provide their own suitable computer equipment, reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.



The role requires availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Working hours in the contractor’s location will therefore change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.

Although this is an independent contractor position, we are looking for someone who wants to work closely with the business owner and wider team and make a significant, long-term contribution to the growth of Garry Howling Recruitment.



Application process



The application process is expected to include:



1. CV/resume submission and initial application review.

2. Shortlisting of selected applicants.

3. Short video introduction of approximately two to four minutes, requested from shortlisted applicants only.

4. Initial interview.

5. Practical assessment task.

6. Final interview.

7. Independent contractor offer.



Applicants who progress through the process may be asked to demonstrate their:



• Research and market-mapping ability.

• Written and spoken communication.

• Commercial judgement and initiative.

• Candidate engagement skills.

• Ability to turn limited information into a practical commercial plan.

• Approach to following tasks and opportunities through to completion.

• Ability to create activity and commercial opportunities without continual direction.

• Confidence when conducting a mock candidate conversation.



All information and work submitted during the application process must be the applicant’s own and must accurately represent their experience and capabilities.

title: AI DTC VIDEO EDITOR
description:
# DTC AI Video Editor



We’re looking for a skilled AI Video Editor who understands what makes direct-response ads convert.



You’ll join a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand, working alongside creative strategists to turn scripts and concepts into compelling paid social ads. You should have proven experience creating performance-focused content for established e-commerce brands,



Our strategists provide the script, angle and brief. You own the visual execution: choosing the right footage, creating what’s missing and making every shot strengthen the message.



## The Role



You’ll produce **4/5  finished ad concepts per week at minimum**, combining traditional editing with original AI-generated content.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Turning scripts and briefs into clear, persuasive visual stories.

- Selecting B-roll that matches the intent and emotion of each line.

- Identifying gaps in the footage and generating stronger visuals with AI.

- Creating convincing AI UGC, animation, product scenes and other creative formats.

- Building strong hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts and visual progression.

- Keeping visuals aligned with the script and sales message throughout the ad.

- Suggesting improvements to concepts and bringing fresh ideas to our strategists.

- Applying feedback and performance insights to improve future creative.

- Taking ownership of each ad from brief to finished delivery.



We expect you to make confident creative decisions and solve visual problems independently.



## What We’re Looking For



You’ll need:



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC or e-commerce brands.

- A portfolio of direct-response paid social ads.

- A strong understanding of hooks, curiosity, emotion, proof, retention and conversion.

- Advanced AI content generation skills, supported by examples of your work.

- Hands-on experience with tools and models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- The ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other production-ready visuals.

- Strong judgment about which visuals will make a line of copy more persuasive.

- A reliable workflow that delivers both quality and volume.

- Clear communication and the ability to act quickly on feedback.



You should be motivated to develop as a direct-response marketer, curious about why ads succeed or fail, and proactive about improving your work.



## How You’ll Approach the Creative



The question behind every visual decision should be:



**“What does the viewer need to see for this message to land?”**



Use existing footage when it serves the concept. Create new footage when it doesn’t. If you see a way to strengthen the brief, bring it forward.



As you edit, you should be thinking about:



- Whether the opening visual makes the hook stronger.

- How closely each shot supports the voiceover.

- Where attention might drop and how to hold it.

- Which claims could be demonstrated visually.

- How the edit builds curiosity, belief and desire.

- Whether a new AI-generated scene would meaningfully improve the concept.



## AI Is a Core Part of the Role



You should be comfortable generating usable, high-quality creative across formats, including:



- AI UGC and character-led scenes.

- Product-integrated scenes and cinematic B-roll.

- Animation and visual metaphors.

- Attention-grabbing hook visuals.

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to film traditionally.



We’ll want to see finished examples and understand which tools you used, how you used them and what you contributed.



## Growth and Development

title: Paid Media Buyer (Performance Marketing)
description:
Starting USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month | Full-time | Remote | Immediate start | Asia Time Zone

You own two of our four newer channels and grow them: TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola.

This is for people who think in ROAS, spot what is working before anyone asks, and want to run a channel rather than upload to one.



---



Apply below:





---



[1] About Ally

Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies.

Founded by leaders who have scaled and operated 8-figure businesses, we partner with top operators and support clients including a NASDAQ-listed company.

We are not a traditional VA agency. We are a modern operating partner.

This role sits with one of our clients, a DTC brand that went from zero to around $100M USD in under three years and now runs paid spend across six platforms.

The brand sells sexual wellness products. The category is high risk for ad and account bans, which is why keeping your accounts alive is a real part of the job. If that is not for you, better to know now.



---



[2] The Role

You own two of four: TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola. Which two is d
 when we assign them, and channels move around as the team grows, so you will not be on the same two forever.

We are hiring for this now and want someone starting as soon as they can.

Nobody here has run these at scale. There is no playbook, no baseline, and in some cases no target yet. You set them. What you write becomes what the team uses after you.

The work is end to end. Who the audience is on your channel, what angle lands with them, what landing page that angle needs, and what assets. What is already working on Meta you adapt. What does not exist on Meta but you think would work on yours, you propose and test.

You are also the only person who knows your channels. When an account gets restricted, and in this category it will, you are the one who diagnoses it, appeals it, and gets it back.

Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. So it has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.

From day one you own: which ads run on your channels, the daily report, your ad accounts including setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, and the advertorials.

For the first month or two, budgets, scaling and cutting go to the marketing lead first. After that they are yours, inside a ROAS floor with no budget cap while it holds.

You do not pick agencies or pay bills. Everything else on your channels is yours.

You assume the method, not the standard. Research it, build it paused, flag it, bring a recommendation. That is yours from day one and we want more of it. Setting a target or a bar, you propose with your reasoning. Anything that moves money or goes live, you ask, for the first month or two.



---



[3] What You'll Do

What you own:

How your two channels perform. The spend, the accounts, setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, flagging billing before a lapse stops a campaign, and the relationship with your platform reps.

The daily report on your channels. Build it and maintain it, and know why each formula works rather than just where to type the number.

Keeping your accounts alive. Watch policy changes, spot the risk early, and act before a channel gets disrupted. There is no one else covering this for you.

The playbook. Write down what works as you learn it, so the next person does not start where you did.

Spotting things first. Underperformance, anomalies and opportunities reach the team from you, not the other way round.

What a normal day looks like:

First thing: check nothing has stopped. Billing, account health, rejected ads or accounts, any policy notice. If something is about to break, you flag it before it does.

Then the report. Pull the numbers, build it, and say what happened, why, and what to do next. It goes out at a fixed time every morning and leadership d
 off it.

Then the work on your channels. New creative live, tests set up, budgets moved, the calls on what to scale and what to cut. Approved by the marketing lead at first, then yours.

All day: ask. Ten questions a day is fine. A quiet week is not.

Every week:

Review what ran and say what to make more of.

Bring back something another brand is doing on your channels that we should test.

Draft one advertorial with AI for approval.



---



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

Your channels are growing. Spend and revenue up, ROAS at or above target.

Your reports are trusted. Leadership d
 off them without checking the platforms, and they have been right every day.

Nothing has stopped. No campaign down from a billing lapse, a rejected account, or a policy change you did not see coming.

You have a repeatable way to test on your channels and you find winners every week, not occasionally.

There is a written playbook for your channels where there was none.



---



[5] What We're Looking For

You have run paid on at least one platform with real spend. Meta or Google is fine, that is where most people's depth sits. Not uploading. You know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero.

Hands-on time on TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit or Taboola. This is the rarest thing on this list and the one we most want. If you have run any of them with your own budget, say which and say what you learned.

You can run an account, not just a campaign. Setup, rejections, billing, replacements, platform reps. You are the only person who knows your channel, so when it breaks you fix it.

You can start from nothing. No SOP, no baseline, no benchmark. You work out what good looks like and write it down.

You read the sheet, you do not just fill it. You know why the formula works and you catch the wrong number before the reader does.

You ask questions constantly. We would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes in it.

Initiative. You see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week who has this and who does not.

You present data clearly. Accurate numbers, clean formatting, a report someone who never opens an ad platform can d
 from.

Meta and Google experience counts. You start on the newer channels, but assignments move around as the team grows, so depth on the big two is worth having and worth telling us about.

Useful, not required: bulk tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, advertorial writing, AI in your workflow, and generating a few assets yourself with AI rather than waiting on an agency.

On creative: our internal team and the agencies produce the main assets, and you tell them what the data says to make more of. For small iterations on your own channel you will not always want to wait for them, so being able to prompt an AI tool into a usable asset is handy. Ten assets, not a hundred. We are not asking you to edit anything by hand.



---



[6] Schedule

5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We confirm which days when we assign your channels.

A sixth day is overtime.



---



[7] What You'll Get

USD $1,000 - $1,400 a month to start, full time

Two weeks of one-to-one walkthrough with the marketing lead, then real decision rights once you have earned them

Two channels of your own on a brand that scaled to around $100M. A track record you can point at later, with the numbers to show for it

The playbook for your channels with your name on it

Paid subscriptions to the tools you need, and direct access to the operators you work with

Fully remote setup

Asia Time Zone



---



[8] HOW TO APPLY

Submit your application here:





You will be asked to:

Upload your CV or LinkedIn profile

Record a short video (2-3 mins) answering:

Which of TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit and Taboola have you personally run ads on, and which have you never touched? Be honest. Most people have none of them and we would rather know now.

Take your strongest platform that is not Meta. Name one thing that works differently there. Something you learned by running it, not by reading about it.

Your ad account gets restricted on a Tuesday morning. What do you do in the first hour?

We are listening for how you think, not how polished you are. No video, no shortlist.

Applications sent outside this link will not be reviewed.
