title: Tax Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Tax Manager will lead ProfitGrid’s finance function and serve as a strategic business partner to the CEO and leadership team. This role will be responsible for the company’s financial strategy, planning and analysis, accounting and reporting, cash management, financial controls, compliance, and overall financial health.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded finance leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, build scalable finance processes, and provide data-driven insights that support ProfitGrid’s growth and profitability.



Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

CPA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, with significant experience in a senior finance leadership role.

Strong experience in FP&A, financial planning, accounting, reporting, budgeting, and cash management.

Experience partnering with senior leadership and supporting strategic business decisions.

Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

Excellent understanding of financial controls, compliance, and risk management.

Experience building or scaling finance processes and teams.

Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commercial acumen.

Experience in a technology, fintech, SaaS, or high-growth environment is an advantage.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Financial Strategy & Business Partnering

Develop and execute ProfitGrid’s overall financial strategy aligned with business objectives.

Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team on strategic and financial decisions.

Provide financial insights, analysis, and recommendations to support business growth and profitability.

Evaluate new business initiatives, investments, and strategic opportunities from a financial perspective.

Establish and monitor financial KPIs to measure business performance.



2. FP&A, Budgeting & Forecasting

Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process.

Develop rolling forecasts and financial models to support business planning.

Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast and identify key variances.

Provide regular management reporting and insights on revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.

Develop scenario analyses to support strategic decision-making.



3. Accounting & Financial Reporting

Oversee the company’s accounting and financial reporting functions.

Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.

Maintain appropriate accounting policies, processes, and controls.

Work closely with external accountants, auditors, tax advisors, and other financial partners.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.



4. Cash Management & Treasury

Oversee cash flow management and liquidity planning.

Monitor working capital and optimize cash utilization.

Develop cash flow forecasts and ensure adequate funding for business operations.

Manage banking relationships and other financial institutions.

Establish appropriate controls around company expenditures and payments.



5. Financial Controls, Risk & Compliance

Establish and strengthen financial policies, processes, and internal controls.

Identify and mitigate financial and operational risks.

Ensure compliance with applicable Philippine tax, statutory, and regulatory requirements.

Support internal and external audits.

Maintain strong governance over financial transactions and company resources.



6. Cost Management & Profitability

Monitor operating expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

Analyze business unit and company-level profitability.

Partner with department heads to improve financial accountability.

Develop frameworks for evaluating the financial impact of business decisions.

Drive initiatives that improve margins and overall financial efficiency.



7. Finance Systems & Process Transformation

Build scalable finance processes and systems that can support ProfitGrid’s growth.

Identify opportunities to automate and streamline finance operations.

Improve the quality, accessibility, and reliability of financial data.

Leverage technology and automation to increase finance efficiency and accuracy.



8. Team Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing finance team.

Establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations.

Develop the team’s technical and commercial finance capabilities.

Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, continuous improvement, and business partnership

title: AEO & Social Media Strategist
description:
The role

We are hiring an AEO and Social Media Strategist to make Scouter the answer people find when they ask how to protect hiring from AI-driven cheating.



You will own how Scouter appears in answer engines such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and on social, especially LinkedIn. Your goal is to turn that visibility into inbound interest from investment firms and recruiting partners. You will work closely with the founding team, and your results will be measured in visibility, qualified conversations, and pipeline.



What you'll do

Answer engine optimization (AEO)

• Audit how AI engines describe Scouter and its category today, and track whether Scouter is cited for the queries that matter.

• Build a query map of what investment firms, recruiters, and candidates ask AI engines about assessment integrity and AI cheating in hiring.

• Create content designed to be cited: clear explainers, FAQs, comparison pages, and data-backed posts, with structured data and consistent definitions of what Scouter is.

• Earn the third-party mentions that answer engines trust, including press, industry coverage, directories, and partner and recruiting-firm pages.

• Report monthly on AI visibility and citations, and adjust the plan based on what moves them.



Social media strategy

• Own Scouter's LinkedIn presence and editorial calendar, and shape the founder's thought-leadership voice.

• Turn product insights and trends into posts, carousels, and short video, using only anonymized and approved data. Client and candidate information is never shared.

• Engage the private equity, recruiting, and HR-tech communities, and amplify launches, partnerships, and press wins.

• Test formats and topics, and tie social performance to qualified inbound conversations.

Across both

• Align messaging with sales and the founders so what people read matches what we say in conversations.

• Support PR by identifying journalists and publications that cover AI and hiring, and by drafting pitches.

What you'll bring

• Experience in content, SEO, growth, or social strategy, ideally in B2B or at an early-stage startup.

• A working understanding of AEO, also called generative engine optimization: how AI engines retrieve and cite sources, and how to test and track that.

• Strong writing that sounds credible to a finance and professional audience.

• A record of growing a LinkedIn or B2B social presence, with results you can point to.

• Comfort with analytics and tools, such as Google Analytics, Search Console, AI-visibility trackers, and social analytics.

• Ownership and speed: you set priorities, ship often, and learn from what the data shows.

Nice to have

• Experience marketing to financial services, private equity, or recruiting and HR-tech buyers.

• Technical SEO skills, including schema markup and structured data.

• Short-form video and basic design skills, in tools such as Canva or Figma.

• Familiarity with hiring, assessments, or trust and safety.

Details and how to apply



To apply, send your resume and one example of AI-search or social work you're proud of, with the results it drove.

title: OUTBOUND SALES REPRESENTATIVE – US MARKET
description:

We’re looking for a confident, driven Sales Representative to join our team long-term.



This is NOT a general VA position.

This is a sales role.



You will be responsible for getting in front of US therapy clinic owners, starting conversations, understanding their needs, qualifying opportunities, handling objections, and booking qualified meetings with our founders.



🎯 THE ROLE



Your primary goal is simple:



Generate qualified sales opportunities for our agency.



You will be the first point of contact between our company and potential clients.



You'll be speaking directly with US-based ABA and speech therapy clinic owners and decision-makers, so confidence, communication skills, and the ability to sell are extremely important.



You will not be responsible for closing the final deal or negotiating pricing. Your job is to create the opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto our founder's calendar.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



📞 Make outbound cold calls to US-based therapy clinics



💬 Speak confidently with business owners and decision-makers



🎯 Identify potential clients and qualify their needs



🧠 Understand basic pain points and communicate how our agency can help



🔥 Handle objections and keep conversations moving



📅 Book qualified sales meetings directly onto our founder's calendar



📧 Follow up with prospects through email and LinkedIn



🔁 Follow up consistently with prospects who aren't ready immediately



📊 Track calls, conversations, follow-ups and outcomes in our CRM



📈 Work toward daily and weekly sales/outreach targets



🤝 Participate in a short daily team stand-up



THIS IS A SALES ROLE! NOT A VA ROLE!



We're specifically looking for someone who enjoys sales.



If you're someone who:



Gets excited by hitting targets

Doesn't mind making lots of calls

Can confidently speak to business owners

Knows how to handle rejection

Can think on their feet

Enjoys persuasion and negotiation

Wants to build a career in sales



We want to hear from you.



If you're primarily looking for data entry, admin, calendar management, or general VA work, this won't be the right position for you.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:



1–3+ years of experience in B2B sales, outbound sales, cold calling, SDR, business development, or lead generation

Excellent spoken English

Confident and natural communication style

Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

Strong objection-handling skills

Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling

Goal-oriented and motivated by KPIs

Excellent follow-up skills

Strong written communication

Comfortable using CRM systems

Willingness to work US Eastern Time hours

💪 YOU NEED TO BE COMFORTABLE WITH REJECTION



Let's be honest:

You're going to hear "no." A lot.



That's sales.

We're looking for someone who doesn't take rejection personally and can pick up the next call with the same energy.



You need to be resilient, competitive, coachable and hungry to improve.



💰 WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary based on experience

Performance bonuses/commission opportunities

Paid training

Sales scripts and proven processes

Training on the ABA/therapy industry

Direct access to the founders

Small team with minimal bureaucracy

Long-term stability

Opportunity to grow into a Senior Sales / Team Lead position



We want someone who can grow with us — not someone who is simply looking for their next short-term VA job.



🌎 WORKING HOURS

You will be working with US-based businesses, so you must be comfortable working US Eastern Time hours.

This means night-shift work for someone based in the Philippines.



We pay a premium for this schedule because we understand that working US hours is a significant commitment.



🎙️ HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:



1. Your CV

2. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about the hardest sales prospect or objection you've ever handled.

3. Your expected monthly salary

4. Tell us briefly about your outbound sales experience.

How many calls were you typically making per day, and what type of businesses were you selling to?



🚨 IMPORTANT

Put SALES in the subject line.

Applications without a voice recording will NOT be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in sales, grow with our company, and become a key member of the team.

If you're hungry, confident, competitive and ready to sell! APPLY!
salary: $600 plus a bonus per meeting booked

title: Senior Social Media Growth Manager & Content Producer
description:
Senior Social Media Growth Manager & Content Producer



Full-time | Remote | Philippines



I’m looking for an experienced, highly creative social media professional to grow my personal brand and manage the daily execution of my social media.



I’m Mary-Anne Gillespie, a sales performance strategist, keynote speaker, and founder of Red Apple Coaching & Consulting. My content focuses on business growth, real estate performance, leadership, recruiting, entrepreneurship, and the discipline behind success.



I have substantial expertise, speaking footage, stories, and ideas. I need someone who can turn those assets into compelling content, build a recognizable brand, and grow an engaged audience that generates business opportunities.



This is an ongoing position for someone who can take ownership, bring ideas, and deliver consistently.



The opportunity



We are building a high-volume, multi-platform content operation inspired by Gary Vaynerchuk’s approach to documenting, repurposing, and distributing content.



Our ambition is to build toward 10-20 published content pieces per day across all channels combined, including short videos, stories, clips, text posts, carousels, and repurposed content. The publishing plan must balance volume with quality, platform relevance, and results.  



You will own the workflow that makes this possible from identifying strong ideas to producing, publishing, and measuring the content.



What you will manage



Instagram,
, LinkedIn, YouTube, with content adapted to each platform’s audience and format.



Your responsibilities will include:



Develop and execute a social media growth strategy with clear priorities and measurable goals.



Own the content calendar, production process, scheduling, and daily publishing.



Turn keynote recordings, interviews, coaching insights, voice notes, photographs, and everyday moments into multiple strong content assets.



Proactively identify compelling angles, hooks, trends, and opportunities that fit my brand.



Write excellent captions, LinkedIn posts, video scripts, headlines, and calls to action in my voice.



Edit polished short-form videos, including Reels, Shorts, with strong openings, pacing, captions, and storytelling.



Produce and package longer YouTube videos, including titles, thumbnails, descriptions, and clips.



Create professional carousels, graphics, stories, and other visual assets with consistent branding.



Curate relevant industry content and develop original commentary grounded in my expertise.



Manage comments and community engagement, and flag relevant inquiries and business opportunities.



Plan, launch, monitor, and improve paid social campaigns within approved budgets, including creative testing and reporting.



Track performance weekly and use the findings to improve content, distribution, and conversion.



Maintain an organized content library and manage tasks, deadlines, and approvals through Asana.



Experience required



You must have demonstrated experience in:



Managing and growing social media accounts for a personal brand, entrepreneur, speaker, or service-based business.



Creating and distributing content across multiple platforms, including LinkedIn and YouTube.



Editing both short-form and long-form video.  Using ai preferably.



Writing compelling English copy and adapting to a founder’s voice.



Designing professional graphics and maintaining brand consistency.



Managing paid social advertising, including Meta Ads Manager, audience targeting, creative testing, and performance reporting.



Running a high-volume content workflow with reliable systems and deadlines.



Using analytics to make decisions and connect social media activity to business outcomes.



Experience with YouTube advertising, LinkedIn advertising, real estate, coaching, or professional services is an advantage. Please specify which advertising platforms you have personally managed.



You should be comfortable with tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent editing software, social scheduling platforms, analytics tools, and Asana.



Who will succeed in this role



You are creative, organized, proactive, and comfortable taking responsibility for results.



You can recognize the strongest moment in a 45-minute presentation and turn it into a video people want to watch. You know how to adapt an idea for LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. You bring recommendations and finished work without needing constant direction.



My voice is direct, intelligent, confident, and human. Your work should capture that personality while maintaining professional standards.



You must also have:



Strong written and spoken English.



Excellent attention to detail.



Reliable internet and equipment suitable for video production.



Availability for agreed working-hour overlap with Eastern Time in Canada.



The ability to manage competing priorities and communicate clearly.



AI tools can support your workflow, but the final content must sound like me, reflect accurate information, and meet a high creative standard.



How success will be measured



Success will include:



Consistent publishing at the agreed volume and quality.



Growth in relevant followers and engaged audiences.



Better video retention, shares, saves, and meaningful engagement.



Increased qualified inquiries for speaking, programs, and business services.



Paid advertising performance against agreed campaign goals.



A reliable production system that makes effective use of my time and content.



Position and compensation



Full-time, ongoing remote position for a professional based in the Philippines.



Compensation will reflect your experience, portfolio, and demonstrated results. Please include your expected monthly rate in PHP and your availability.



How to apply



Please include:



A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit.



Links to accounts you have personally managed, with a clear explanation of your responsibilities.



Examples of results you achieved, including the timeframe, starting point, and whether growth was organic or paid.



Your portfolio, including short videos, long-form video work, graphics or carousels, and written posts.



Examples of advertising campaigns you personally managed, including budget, objectives, and results where available.



Your expected monthly compensation, start date, and availability for Eastern Time overlap.  We also will create a great bonus system for growth on platforms 



Application subject line: Social Growth — Mary-Anne



I’m looking for someone who can help build a powerful, recognizable brand through excellent content, consistent execution, and measurable growth.

title: Virtual Assistant (Family Manager & PA) – Long-Term Role – 3 Vacancies, Choose Your Shift!
description:
TYPE OF WORK

Full Time (fixed shifts, 5 days on, 2 days off)



WAGE / SALARY

$450 / month (same pay for all 3 slots), paid monthly in arreas via bank transfer.



JOB OVERVIEW



ABOUT US

You'll be working for a very close, warm UK family of 8, with family members spread across a few countries in Europe. We're looking for a small team of three people to be their family managers and PAs. We don't want someone for a few months. We want people who'll stay long-term, grow with them and become an extended member of the family.



HOW IT WORKS

- You'll be part of a team of 3 VAs, with a daily handover between shifts and a weekly team day.

- You work through a remote desktop (RDP) connection to a UK computer, so you can use UK shops, booking sites and the family's accounts.

- You talk to the family on WhatsApp (connected to the same computer), and we give you a UK and European phone line and dialler to make and take calls.

- 2 rest days every week, always. We don't want anyone burning out.



THE 3 SLOTS (all times UK, with Philippine time in brackets)

We need someone from 8am to midnight UK time, 7 days a week. Each slot is 5 shifts of 8.5 hours.



* SLOT 1 - DAY

- Mon to Fri, 8:00am-4:30pm UK (4:00pm-12:30am PH)

- Off Sat and Sun

- Best for: someone strong on the phone. Most calls to UK businesses, insurers and airlines happen in the day.



* SLOT 2 - EVENING

- Wed to Sun, 3:30pm-midnight UK (11:30pm-8:00am PH)

- Off Mon and Tue

- Best for: someone happy to work a night shift in the Philippines. This slot handles evening grocery cutoffs and midnight tennis court bookings.



* SLOT 3 - SWING / WEEKEND

- Sat and Sun, 8:00am-4:30pm UK (4:00pm-12:30am PH)

- Mon and Tue, 3:30pm-midnight UK (11:30pm-8:00am PH)

- Wed, 12:00pm-8:30pm UK (8:00pm-4:30am PH)

- Off Thu and Fri

- Best for: someone flexible who's comfortable with a changing shift pattern.



TEAM DAY

Wednesday is our team day. All three of you overlap that afternoon for a catch-up, training and planning. 



HANDOVERS

There's a 1-hour overlap between the day and evening person every day, so nothing gets dropped. We use a shared WhatsApp group and a handover log.



It's not a busy-all-day job. Some tasks are time-critical (booking tennis courts the second they open, placing grocery orders before the shop cutoff) and the rest of the time is gentler.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Order groceries daily for the next day. Compare price and quality across Asda, Tesco and Amazon, and skip a day when the fridge is full.

- Book tennis courts (some open 2 weeks ahead at midnight UK time, others at 8am).

- Book flights, hotels and Airbnbs for the family, and hunt for the best deals.

- Book restaurants for the family in various locations, researching and finding new and interesting ones based on their preferences.

- Plan family trips, including a monthly family get-together, and date activities for the kids and their partners.

- Find thoughtful birthday presents and plan parties for family and friends. Surprises must stay secret!

- Handle paperwork like insurance and licence renewals.

- Reply to
s on behalf of family members and organise whatever needs organising.

- Book Ubers and other transport.

- Compare prices and order things.

- Run bigger trip plans by getting quotes from travel agents and booking sites like 
.

- Put together credit card disputes and complaint letters.

- Find tutors and other help for the kids.

- Make and take phone calls as a PA.

- Keep our calendar, birthdays, passport expiries and subscriptions under control.

- Spot and be flexible to other ways to make our lives easier. We'll always listen to your ideas.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Excellent spoken and written English. You'll be speaking to UK businesses by phone.

- Reliable internet, a laptop or PC and a headset

- A quiet place for calls and a backup plan for power and internet

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions exactly

- Comfort with RDP, WhatsApp,
 and online booking sites

- Honesty and discretion. You'll have access to family accounts, so trust is everything.

- A long-term mindset



TO APPLY:

Please
 a copy of your CV and your introduction video (specific to this role) directly to: 



IMPORTANT: IN THE SUBJECT PUT "FAMILY VA JOB"



*IMPORTANT 2: If you do not send this directly to the above
 address, your application will not be received!*



AS PART OF YOUR APPLICATION, PLEASE SEND YOUR CV AND ALSO RECORD A SHORT VIDEO ANSWERING THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS:



1. What is your experience with being a virtual assistant / family manager? How many of the activities listed above have you already done before? Tell us more about that: the family you were working with, how long it lasted, and why the relationship ended.



2. What is your life situation? Are you available to dedicate yourself full-time to being an extended part of this family? And for how long would you be looking to work together?



3. How good are you at multi-tasking and keeping multiple conversations with multiple parties at once?



4. Which slot(s) can you commit to? Please rank Slot 1, Slot 2 and Slot 3 from most to least preferred, and tell us if you're happy to work a night shift (Slot 2) or a changing shift pattern (Slot 3). 



5. When are you ready to start?



6. Please confirm you understand the pay, the fixed shifts, and your 2 rest days a week depending on which slot you can do / are offered.





We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
# Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

**Local SEO | Website Optimization | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We are a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term.



Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results.



We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team.



This is a **direct-hire position**.



It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time.



## Your Primary Goal



Your main responsibility is straightforward:



**Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.**



Everything else supports that goal.



Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us.



Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients.



Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results.



## What You Will Own



### Website Management & Optimization



You will help continuously improve our website by:



- Updating and improving website pages and content

- Managing WordPress or a similar CMS

- Improving site speed and mobile performance

- Improving usability and conversion flow

- Identifying and correcting technical SEO issues

- Fixing broken links, indexing problems, page structure, and other technical issues

- Identifying pages that are underperforming and improving them



### Local SEO



You will help us improve local search visibility throughout our service areas.



Responsibilities include:



- Keyword research based on **search intent**

- Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone

- On-page SEO

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- Header structure

- Internal linking

- Content optimization

- Local service-area optimization

- Monitoring rankings and making adjustments based on performance

- Supporting appropriate citations and local directory consistency



### Landing Pages & Conversion Optimization



You will:



- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Develop location-specific pages where appropriate

- Improve calls-to-action and messaging

- Analyze conversion performance

- Make changes based on actual results rather than assumptions

- Help turn website visitors into qualified inquiries



### Google Business Profile Management



You will manage and improve our Google Business Profiles, including:



- Profile optimization

- Posts and updates

- Photos

- Service and business information

- Review monitoring

- Review-response support

- Tracking calls, website clicks, and direction requests

- Monitoring local map visibility

- Identifying opportunities to improve local search performance



### Call-Driven Digital Marketing



We operate a local service business.



That means **phone calls matter.**



You will help us understand which marketing activities actually create qualified conversations.



This may include:



- Supporting Google Ads and other digital campaigns

- Improving ad landing pages

- Assisting with call-tracking systems

- Tracking where calls and inquiries originate

- Reviewing lead quality

- Identifying campaigns and keywords that generate good inquiries

- Identifying campaigns that waste money

- Improving messaging based on actual client conversations and lead quality



## Reporting & Accountability



We expect clear, useful weekly reporting.



We do not want large reports filled with numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



- How many qualified inquiries were generated?

- How many phone calls were generated?

- Where did those inquiries come from?

- What improved?

- What declined?

- What worked?

- What did not work?

- What did you change?

- What should we do next?



Your weekly reporting may include:



- Calls generated

- Inquiry volume

- Website performance

- Organic search performance

- Google Business Profile activity

- Ranking changes

- Landing-page performance

- Issues discovered

- Work completed

- Next priorities



## What We Value



We are looking for someone who:



- Focuses on **results rather than activity**

- Understands that traffic without conversion has limited value

- Executes without constant supervision

- Thinks in systems and repeatable processes

- Looks for the root cause of problems

- Takes ownership of their work

- Pays close attention to details

- Communicates clearly and honestly

- Is comfortable being measured on real outcomes

- Can explain technical issues in understandable language

- Continues improving rather than simply maintaining what already exists



We especially value someone who is comfortable saying:



**“This is not working. Here is why, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather identify a problem early and fix it than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## Required Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or a similar CMS

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar

- Call tracking or lead tracking



Experience working with a **local service business** is strongly preferred.



Experience with home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven business is a plus.



## This Role Is NOT For You If



This position is probably not a fit if:



- Your primary experience is social-media posting

- You primarily focus on followers, likes, or impressions

- You rely heavily on spammy backlinks or questionable SEO shortcuts

- You prefer discussing strategy instead of implementing it

- You need constant direction before taking action

- You are looking for a temporary project

- You are an agency or outsourcing company

- You plan to subcontract the work to someone else

- You are currently managing several employers or clients and intend to continue doing so



## Full-Time Commitment



This is a **full-time, dedicated position**.



If hired, this is expected to be your **primary full-time employment**.



We are not looking for someone who is simultaneously working multiple full-time jobs or servicing multiple clients during their scheduled working hours with us.



We want someone who can give the role their professional attention, become deeply familiar with our organization, and grow with the company over the long term.



## Role Structure



- Full-time

- Remote / Virtual

- Direct hire

- Individual applicants only

- No agencies

- No outsourcing teams

- Long-term opportunity

- Consistent working schedule

- Performance-focused

- Opportunity for increased responsibility based on results



## Application Process



We pay attention to how candidates follow instructions.



### Step 1 — Initial Application



Please provide:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience



2. At least **two examples** of websites you have worked on



3. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed



4. Examples of SEO work that produced actual calls, leads, or inquiries



5. In **five sentences or less**, answer:



**How would you increase qualified phone calls for a local home care company?**



6. List the marketing, SEO, analytics, and call-tracking tools you regularly use



7. Confirm the following:



**“I am applying as an individual, not as an agency or outsourcing company.”**



8. Also confirm:



**“If hired, this will be my primary full-time position, and I will not work another full-time job or service other clients during my scheduled working hours.”**



### Step 2 — Paid Skills Assessment



Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short **paid practical assessment**.



This is a real-world task designed to evaluate how you think and execute.



You may be asked to:



- Review a service page

- Identify SEO problems

- Identify conversion problems

- Recommend practical improvements

- Rewrite a section of website content

- Provide a short action plan



We use this assessment to evaluate:



- How you analyze problems

- How clearly you communicate

- Whether you prioritize correctly

- Whether you can execute

- Whether you focus on outcomes rather than theory



**We do not ask candidates to perform unpaid work.**



## Final Note



We are building a stable, long-term marketing system.



We are not interested in hacks, shortcuts, inflated numbers, or activity for the sake of activity.



We want someone who can become a trusted part of our team, take responsibility for an important business function, and continuously improve results.



If you take ownership, execute consistently, communicate honestly, and focus on generating qualified inquiries, **this role can grow significantly over time.**



### One Final Instruction



If you have read this entire job posting, include the word:



**GEMINI**



in the subject line or title of your application.



Applications that do not include **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

title: Copywriter
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You'll write the copy that sits at the center of our growth. It's work that goes live quickly and is measured by real results, so you'll know what worked within days.



For a gifted writer who's fascinated by persuasion and wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of the voice of a growing brand.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Write words that move people. Stories and copy that pull a skeptical reader in, build belief, and move them to act. You'll lead with the angle, the hook, and the proof that earn the click and the order.



Script video that holds attention. Write the scripts for the videos that carry our brand: the hook in the first seconds, the story that keeps people watching, and the line that closes it.



Own the brand voice. Make Cellexia Labs sound like itself everywhere a customer meets us: confident, clear, and credible.



Turn insight into messaging. Dig into customer reviews, support conversations, and ingredient science to find the language customers actually use, then build every piece around it.



Make complex things simple. Take formulation details and ingredient science and turn them into benefits a customer understands in seconds, while staying accurate and compliant.



Test relentlessly. Ship variations of angles, hooks, and openings, read the results with the marketing team, and double down on what wins. Your best work is the work the data backs.



What we look for



Command of the craft. You write sharply and clearly, and you can tell a line that lands from one that merely sounds good. You edit your own work hard.



A pull toward persuasion. You're fascinated by what makes people say yes: the customer's doubts, the offer, the proof, the words that earn trust. You don't need a background in sales or persuasion. You need real curiosity about how words move people, and the drive to learn from what the numbers tell you.



Ownership. You treat every piece of copy as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Curiosity. You research before you write. You're willing to understand ingredients, customers, and competitors until the words come from real understanding.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years of professional writing, with a portfolio that shows it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or other consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. You'll never wait on a chain of sign-offs. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Copy goes live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your words move the numbers.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Build efficient production processes for digital courses, workbooks, and personal development programs.



Coordinate technical workflows with our existing Kajabi specialist.



4. AI Marketing & Advertising



Develop AI-assisted SEO and website optimization workflows.



Automate content creation for social media and marketing.



Explore AI systems for Meta advertising, ad creation, campaign tracking, and performance analysis.



Develop lead generation,
 marketing, and customer engagement automations.



5. AI Systems Integration & Automation



Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Google Workspace, Kajabi, and other business applications where appropriate.



Build AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks.



Research and recommend the most cost-effective tools and software.



Determine when existing software is preferable to custom-built solutions.



Document systems so they can be maintained and expanded as the business grows.



Required Skills



Advanced experience with Claude, ChatGPT, and AI agent development.



Strong proficiency in n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.



Experience with API integrations, webhooks, and workflow automation.



Ability to build AI knowledge management systems and dashboards.



Strong technical problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.



Experience implementing reliable, practical AI solutions for businesses.



Ability to independently research, recommend, and implement technology.



Excellent English communication and project management skills.



Experience with Kajabi, AI video generation, SEO, Meta Ads, and online education platforms is an advantage.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into a functioning system.



For example, we may say:



"I want to upload a completed course script and have AI automatically prepare the branded visuals, voiceovers, video segments, and materials needed for publication."



We need someone who can evaluate the options, explain the best approach, recommend the necessary tools, and build the solution.



We value someone who is proactive, resourceful, organized, and comfortable taking ownership of a project from beginning to completion.



Project Structure & Compensation



We will begin with a paid trial project.



The initial project will be agreed upon in advance, with clearly defined deliverables, timelines, and payment milestones.



Upon satisfactory completion of the first project, we will offer another project. We intend to continue working this way, assigning and paying for individual projects as they are successfully completed.



Our goal is to establish a long-term working relationship with a skilled AI specialist who can progressively build and manage our AI infrastructure.



Some projects will involve one-time system development, while others may lead to ongoing automation management, optimization, and technical support.



We are open to working with one highly skilled individual or a small team with complementary expertise.



How to Apply



Please include the following information:



Your AI automation experience: Describe the types of systems and AI agents you have built.

We look forward to finding a talented technical partner to help us build a highly automated, efficient, and scalable business.



We cant wait to meet you!!

We care more about what you have actually produced than how impressive your resume sounds.

You should be comfortable hearing:

• "Just send me an
."

DAILY ACTIVITY

Calls → Conversations → Decision-makers → Qualified prospects → Appointments → Shows → Clients

COMPENSATION

$500 USD/month base



Plus:

• Uncapped performance bonuses



Performance bonuses are tied to qualified appointments that attend and clients generated from your appointments.



There is no ceiling on performance earnings.



The exact bonus structure will be explained during the interview.



Our goal is to reward people who actually produce results.



TRAINING

HOW WE MEASURE PERFORMANCE

We track the entire sales funnel:

Outbound Attempts

↓

Connections

↓

Decision-Maker Conversations

↓

Qualified Prospects

↓

Appointments Booked

↓

Appointments Showed

↓

Closed Clients

You will also receive coaching based on actual recorded calls.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term position with the company.



As the sales operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential and additional responsibility for strong performers.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Please answer every question below.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of B2B cold-calling experience do you have?

2. How many years of appointment-setting experience do you have?

3. What industries or types of businesses have you previously called?

Please explain.

If you don't know, just say so.

• Receptionists

• Consumers

10. What was the most difficult objection you regularly encountered, and how did you handle it?



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 1

Imagine you're calling a med spa owner.

They say:

"We already have a receptionist. We're not interested in an AI receptionist."

What would you say?

Write your response exactly as you would say it on the phone.



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 2

The owner says:

"Just send me an
."

What would you say?



VOICE RECORDING

Please provide a 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Tell us:

• Your sales experience

• Your cold-calling experience

• What type of businesses you've called

• Why you believe you'd be a strong fit for this position



We want to hear your natural speaking voice, confidence, communication style, and professionalism.



WORK SETUP

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Quality headset/microphone

• Quiet workspace

• Ability to work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



ATTENTION TO DETAIL

At the very end of your application, include:

VELO SALES



This lets us know that you read the entire job post.

title: Full-Stack Developer (Next.js, Supabase) who builds with AI coding agents
description:
We are a US e-commerce company. We are building one internal platform that runs our marketing operation: competitor ad monitoring, script writing with AI, AI video production, hiring and customer tools.



The code is written by AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code). We need one developer who directs them and owns the result. This is a long-term role, not a single project.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Turn the founder's ideas into precise tasks for the agents

- Review what the agents built before it goes live, and catch what they got wrong

- Fix by hand what the agents cannot fix

- Keep everything that already works working

- Keep scrapers, job queues and integrations running without supervision

- Report in plain English to a founder who is not a developer



STACK

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres), Vercel, GitHub, Cursor, Claude Code.



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You are a real developer. You can read a diff, write SQL and debug by hand. AI tools make you faster, they do not replace your skills.

- You already use AI coding agents in your daily work

- You have built and maintained a web app that real people use

- You check before you trust. When an agent says "done", you verify it.

- You write clear English

- You work on your own tasks yourself. No agencies, no subcontracting.



NOT A FIT

- Prompt-only or no-code profiles (Zapier, n8n, Make) with no software background

- Developers who want a ticket list. This is ownership of a product.



HOW TO APPLY

Step 1 is a 14-minute test. It is the only way to apply:





Do not message us on OnlineJobs and do not send a CV. We only look at test results, and we contact by
 the candidates who pass.



NEXT STEPS

A second short test, then a paid trial task, then a short live call.



TERMS

Remote. Contractor agreement with confidentiality terms. Time tracking.
